strings.actor_1: I'm not in a good mood. Go away!
strings.actor_1_3: What did Ms Charm tell you?
strings.actor_1_5: Ah, always so classy. She would never talk to just anyone.
strings.actor_1_6: I'm not just anyone. I'm the local graveyard keeper.
strings.actor_1_6a: Soon to be <Prior> of the local church.
strings.actor_1_6a_1: Phh... how primitive. I'm a well-known poet... in certain small circles. My name is Vagner.
strings.actor_1_6b: Plus, I'm <Prior> of the local church.
strings.actor_1_6b_1: I'm a well-known poet... in certain small circles. My name is Vagner.
strings.actor_1_7: One day I'll read my poem to her... And then we'll...
strings.actor_1_8: But first I need to write it, and I am catastrophically out of <Paper> and <Ink>.
strings.actor_1_9: Maybe you can get me some?
strings.actor_2_1a_1: Great! Ink is the blood of poetry! Hm... That sounds good. I should write that down...
strings.actor_2_1ab_1: Now I have all the supplies I need. I should start writing my poem to Ms Charm.
strings.actor_2_1ab_2: But I'm kinda out of inspiration. Every poet knows this feeling.
strings.actor_2_1ab_3: I should start with something simple, and that'll pick me up!
strings.actor_2_1ab_4: If you want, I can write something simple for you.
strings.actor_2_1ab_6: Practically. Just bring me some wine to replenish my poetic energy. — But only the good stuff!
strings.actor_2_1ab_7: Don't forget that I'm well-known poet! ... among a select few.
strings.actor_2_1b_1: Good, paper! Paper is... paper is...
strings.actor_2_1b_2: An extension of the poet's soul...
strings.actor_2_1b_3: Meh. Let's assume there's nothing poetic about paper ...
strings.actor_2_1c_1: You may have some of it in your church. Or you can make it.
strings.actor_2_1c_2: I'm just not used to manual labor. But a skillful man such as you can surely do it easily.
strings.actor_2_1c_3: Also you could get some from the <Old Astrologer>. He used to go to the <Lighthouse> every (d1).
strings.actor_2_1c_4: He was my supplier before we had this ridiculous fight.
strings.actor_2_1d_1: He's old and mad. Whereas I've been studying for 3... almost 3 years at the <Town University>.
strings.actor_2_1d_2: Can you believe he turned out to be an idiot? He told me that the earth is round! What nonsense.
strings.actor_2_1d_2a: Yep. It's flat as a pan!
strings.actor_2_1d_2b_1: Oh god! You should definitely meet him. The mad <Astrologer> and the <Graveyard Keeper> — two wise men...
strings.actor_2_1d_2b_2: Hm... That could make for a pretty funny poem...
strings.actor_2_1d_3: This <Astrologer> must be the smartest man around. Maybe he'll be able to help me get back home.
strings.actor_2_1e_1: It's on a cliff to the east of the village. It hasn't seen active use for a while.
strings.actor_2_1e_2: Bless the <Dead Horse> for staying open. One day I'll write a poem about this place. Maybe even a couple lines about you.
strings.actor_3a_1: Good wine is my friend! Here's a story.
strings.actor_3a_2: It seem like wine doesn't replenish my poetic energy any more.
strings.actor_3a_3: I'm so sad! I'm pathetic! All my stories suck!
strings.actor_3a_5: Go away! I wasted everything on you! How can Ms Charm fall in love with me now?!
strings.actor_inspiration_1: Let me taste it... Oh, I feel so inspired!
strings.actor_inspiration_10: It's still worth it! Here is the song.
strings.actor_inspiration_12: It's a monster! He's trying to kill this poor guy!
strings.actor_inspiration_15: Let me go. I'm the son of the Lord Commander!
strings.actor_inspiration_2: Now just give me a little time. Come back later! For now, I must focus!
strings.actor_inspiration_3: Oh @#&!! Stay where you are! I have a sword!
strings.actor_inspiration_6: The fly agaric infusion... It seems the legends only reported half of the effects.
strings.actor_inspiration_7: I've written the greatest song in the world. But the deeper I looked into my soul, the more I turned into this.
strings.actor_inspiration_8: And when I finished the song, this is what I became. Ms Charm will never love me now.
strings.actor_inspiration_info: We're screwed. I'm growing hair in strange places.
strings.actor_inspiration_info_1: Meet me at night at sea cliffs near the <Mountain Fort>!
strings.actor_song_1: Vagner! You have one-in-a-lifetime chance my friend!
strings.actor_song_2: Ms Charm needs a love song. Who but you could write it?
strings.actor_song_4: But what if I write a bad one.
strings.actor_song_5: You're a smart and talented guy. Just write about your feelings.
strings.actor_song_6: No I can't. I need extra inspiration!
strings.actor_song_7: At university the other students mentioned a legend that fly agaric infusion opens the floodgates of inspiration!
strings.actor_song_8: The infusion should be made with a very strong alcohol.
strings.actor_song_9: Ok. I'll try to make this infusion for you.
strings.actress_ jewelry_1: Well that looks so nice! The design is so fresh.
strings.actress_ jewelry_2: I can definitely sell a lot of them to the noble ladies in <The Town>.
strings.actress_ jewelry_4: Sure. I'll tell everyone about your vegetables too.
strings.actress_ song_done_1: Here's your song. It was written specially for you.
strings.actress_ song_done_10: Well. I don't know how to explain. He was captured by the guards. He's at the <Mountain Fort>.
strings.actress_ song_done_11: And in his present state, I don't think he'll be alive for much longer.
strings.actress_ song_done_12: Hold me, I am going to faint...
strings.actress_ song_done_15: Hm... This looks like the perfect opportunity for <Astrologer> to show how much he cares...
strings.actress_ song_done_16: I'll try to help. You just stay here for a while.
strings.actress_ song_done_5: It gives me little butterflies in my stomach!
strings.actress_ song_done_6: Who wrote this? His love is so pure!
strings.actress_ song_done_7: It's a real declaration of love. He's understood me...
strings.actress_ song_done_8: It was written by a poet who used to write here at the tavern. He's in love with you.
strings.actress_ song_done_9: Oh, I remember him. He was so shy. Where is he now?
strings.actress_1_3: I am a graveyard keeper and I want to ask you some questions...
strings.actress_1_4: I see. You know how many times a day I hear that same mumbling?
strings.actress_1_5: I have no time for you, little man. Come back when you have more faith in yourself.
strings.actress_2_1: Hello, darling. How can I help you?
strings.actress_2a_4: I think you owe me an apology. I'm not a small man. I'm a respected <Graveyard Keeper>.
strings.actress_2a_5: But I'm also a big fan, so you can just call me <Keeper>.
strings.actress_2a_6: Hm. Maybe there's something to you after all...The contrast between your dirty job and you manner.
strings.actress_2a_8: You must compliment me not only on my talent but also on my beauty... I'd like to hear something nice.
strings.actress_2a_9: That was easy. Seems like that this <Faith> things really works here.
strings.actress_2b_1a_1_1: Do you know a man named <Snake>? I need to meet him.
strings.actress_2b_1a_1_2: I met <Snake> in the <Church Cellar>. But he's not very talkative. Maybe you can help me make a deal with him.
strings.actress_2b_1a_2: And you seemed so promising. I should have known there was something wrong with you.
strings.actress_2b_1a_3: I can't imagine what normal business someone could have with that sneaky bastard.
strings.actress_2b_1a_4: Oh, by the way. If you see him, please throw this fake coin into his face. And then come back here and tell me how he reacted.
strings.actress_2b_1a_5_1: So, where can I find him?
strings.actress_2b_1a_6_1: I believe every (d3) he still tries to open that gate in the <Church Cellar>.
strings.actress_2b_1a_7_1: Oh boy. There was a time he seemed young and hopeful!
strings.actress_2b_1b_1: Can you help me get a <Town Pass>?
strings.actress_2b_1b_2: What else do you need? Ha ha. Should I spend night with you too?
strings.actress_2b_1b_3: You need to know someone better before you ask questions like that.
strings.actress_2b_1b_4: I'm not sure. Are we still talking about a <Town Pass>, or about...
strings.actress_2b_1b_7: One of my friends told me that in exchange of some favors and decent amount of money, <Snake> can get you a <Town Pass>.
strings.actress_2b_1b_8: Or was it <Bishop> who arranged it... Hmm, I forgot.
strings.actress_afterall_2: I can't think of anything apart from Vagner...
strings.actress_afterall_3: He's safe, I know. But I want to be with him so badly.
strings.actress_afterall_4: I hope to see him or his father at the <Royal Concert>.
strings.actress_afterall_5: But it's been postponed. So I've been a bit nervous lately.
strings.actress_afterall_6: It's a blessing that now I have a father who can support me.
strings.actress_father_1: Ms Charm, you seem so lonely. Do you have a family?
strings.actress_father_10: He did nothing good for me. I don't care who he is!
strings.actress_father_2: My dear friend. You are so kind to me. It seems like you're the only one who talks to me like I'm a person.
strings.actress_father_3: I feel so lonely... Alone in a crowd of admirers.
strings.actress_father_4: It's my curse. My mother died. I messed up my relationships with my relatives...
strings.actress_father_5: All my life, I've been looking for a charming prince... but I'm cursed.
strings.actress_father_6: It's not a joke. My mother told me that her <Necklace> would help me find love. And I sold it...
strings.actress_father_7: I may know who your father is...
strings.actress_father_8: My father is a dishonorable, deceitful man.
strings.actress_father_9: He left my Mom... And she never got over it.
strings.actress_intro_2: You Wanna Be Loved By Me.
strings.actress_lute_done_1: Here's the paperwork. She can go with you to the concert.
strings.actress_lute_done_10: Besides, it's not like I'll forget to thank you — my sweet.
strings.actress_lute_done_11: I don't like it. But I guess the ends justify the means.
strings.actress_lute_done_2: Wonderful! We just need to correct her age a little bit.
strings.actress_lute_done_3: Plus two years. That'll make everything a little easier.
strings.actress_lute_done_4: Hmm, the correction looks sloppy. It's pretty obvious that someone corrected the number.
strings.actress_lute_done_5: Now I need an Aristocrat to counter-sign the paper. But I don't want to ask just anyone.
strings.actress_lute_done_6: The wrong rumor could be the death of my reputation. Maybe you could get some <Aristocrat Papers>?
strings.actress_lute_done_7: Then I'd only need your signature.
strings.actress_lute_done_9: You're one to talk. I bet you get up to all sorts of illegal stuff at your graveyard!
strings.actress_marketing_1: I was wondering if you'd like to help me. I need you to promote my company in <The Town>.
strings.actress_marketing_10: Something with a graveyard motif. And I'll promote your company.
strings.actress_marketing_11: Plus, if your jewelry is any good, I can sell a lot of it in <The Town>.
strings.actress_marketing_2: Could you tell everyone that you like Graveyard Veggies?
strings.actress_marketing_3: That they help you stay beautiful?
strings.actress_marketing_4: I'm sorry... But can't you hear how that sounds? 'Graveyard Veggies'?!
strings.actress_marketing_5: Mmm... Yeah, maybe that's not the best name. But the graveyard is a sacred place, and our vegetables are really good.
strings.actress_marketing_7: I don't need any money. But I would like some jewelry.
strings.actress_marketing_8: There's been nothing new in <The Town> for a long ago. Just old fashioned rings and earrings.
strings.actress_marketing_9: I heard you're rather gifted. You decorated your church quite nicely. Maybe you could make some jewelry for me!
strings.actress_money_back_1: <Snake> told me that he didn't have your <Necklace> anymore.
strings.actress_money_back_10: Ah, I don't know why, but she doesn't like me... She's especially jealous of my friendship with <Alisa>.
strings.actress_money_back_11: I'll try to get you some <Perfume>. I could even try to make some myself...
strings.actress_money_back_2: That crook!  So you can't help this poor woman after all.
strings.actress_money_back_3: Actually he told me where your <Necklace> is. I'll try to get it back for you.
strings.actress_money_back_5: Speaking of sweet things. Have you ever had a whiff of <Miss Chain's> perfume?
strings.actress_money_back_7: Ah... Even you like it. I definitely need a vial.
strings.actress_money_back_8: Can you talk to her and get me one?
strings.actress_on_the_way: Just keep away from me, ok?
strings.actress_parfume_ready_1: Here you go — a vial of <Perfume>.
strings.actress_parfume_ready_2: Ah. Let me kiss you! I am so happy... Ha ha!
strings.actress_parfume_ready_3: I'll wear it to my concert at the Royal Palace. Finally I will reach the pinnacle of my career!
strings.actress_parfume_ready_4: So many things still remain to be prepared.
strings.actress_parfume_ready_5: By my sins, you are so sweet to me. Maybe you can help me a little bit more.
strings.actress_parfume_ready_6: I need a romantic story for the opening of the concert. Maybe you'll think of something.
strings.actress_parfume_ready_7: I'm a bad writer myself. And I don't want something trivial.
strings.actress_parfume_ready_8: Hmm... I think I know where I can get a good story for you.
strings.actress_parfume_ready_9: Oh... You're the kind of man I could fall in love with. Ha ha!
strings.actress_snake_back_1: <Snake> said that it was a joke.
strings.actress_snake_back_2: Tell him to give back my money! Real money this time!
strings.actress_snake_back_3: And if he can't find my mother's <Necklace>, then the deal is off!
strings.actress_snake_back_5: It was the only thing left of my Mom. She told me to keep it. She told me that this <Necklace> will make me happy and feel love.
strings.actress_snake_back_6: And I sold it to pay for a chance to sing before the King. Now I'd gladly buy it back, but I can't find it.
strings.actress_snake_back_7: Snake. Everybody knows he can find anything in town... So I paid him. And he took my money... And now I have no money and no <Necklace> either!
strings.actress_snake_back_8: You're a strong, intelligent man. I'm sure you can find a way to help a poor woman.
strings.actress_story_gold_1: It's a love <Story>. I hope it will get the audience into the right mood.
strings.actress_story_gold_11: Ah, it's not a big deal. I just need her father to formally grant her permission, so she can travel with me to <The Town>.
strings.actress_story_gold_12: He doesn't approve of her musical interests. But maybe you'll be able to convince him.
strings.actress_story_gold_2: What would I ever do without you?
strings.actress_story_gold_4: Ha ha. By the way, do you know the local <Farmer>?
strings.actress_story_gold_6: Good. Talk to him... Man to man.
strings.actress_story_gold_7: I need his daughter <Alisa> to accompany me to the Royal concert!
strings.actress_story_gold_8: She's so good! And so beautiful. Maybe some nobleman will appreciate her beauty.
strings.actress_story_gold_9: Even the King himself, perhaps... The poor girl is mute, but that can be a big advantage for her!
strings.actress_title_1: Give me <Alisa's Paper>. I can sign it.
strings.actress_title_10: Help me! Help me please. My life is depends on it.
strings.actress_title_11: Hmm... I might know a poet who could write a new song for you.
strings.actress_title_4: Hm. I thought you'd be taller. It didn't make you handsome either.
strings.actress_title_5: You're my only friend! Can you help me one more time?
strings.actress_title_6: What is it now, Ms Charm?
strings.actress_title_7: I'm desperately in need of a new song! I was just going to sing my old hits...
strings.actress_title_8: But I've been advised to perform something new as well.
strings.actress_title_9: I can write some lyrics, but I'm not a poet.

strings.astrolog_expedition_9: With my esteemed name on a cover, it should do well.
strings.astrologer_1_0: It seems like he's looking right through me.
strings.astrologer_1_11: Bring me a <Skull>. It's pretty illegal. But who cares about that stupid Inquisitor's law!
strings.astrologer_1_12: The talking one? Gerry? He's kinda my friend. I don't think it would be appropriate...
strings.astrologer_1_13: No, I just need a simple <Skull> from any old <Dead Body>!
strings.astrologer_1_2: I used to be. Now I'm more of a lost soul in this dead-end world.
strings.astrologer_1_3: I'm the new Graveyard Keeper. And seems I need your help.
strings.astrologer_1_4: Everyone needs something. Except me... Knowledge brings only sadness, young man...
strings.astrologer_1_6: Your trivial needs are meaningless to me...
strings.astrologer_1_7: So there's no way you can help me?
strings.astrologer_1_8: Let me see. You're looking after the Graveyard...
strings.astrologer_2a_1a_2: Hmm... I have some. Actually I have a lot of useful things.
strings.astrologer_2a_1a_3: Some of it may be useful for a beginning scientist such as yourself.
strings.astrologer_2a_1a_4: I can't stand those chumps at the <University>. I'd rather earn a little extra coin elsewhere.
strings.astrologer_2a_1b_2: A friend told me that you might know how to activate the <Portal> on <Witch hill>.
strings.astrologer_2a_1b_3: I've never heard about it... Maybe not exactly 'never', but at least not for many years. In another life, I had a friend.
strings.astrologer_2a_1b_4: By the way, he was a Graveyard Keeper like you. And he was mad about this <Portal>.
strings.astrologer_2a_1b_5: It's amazing how much he knew about this Portal!
strings.astrologer_2a_1b_6a_1: He just disappeared. Hasn't been seen or heard from since.
strings.astrologer_2a_1b_6a_2: I tried to find him. But nobody knew him. I even started thinking he was just a figment of my imagination.
strings.astrologer_2a_1b_6a_3: It was a hard time for me...
strings.astrologer_2a_1b_6b_1: Actually I don't know his name. We always used to call him by his nickname — <Keeper>.
strings.astrologer_2a_1b_6c_1: I think he found a way activate it. It was something magical, so I don't remember.
strings.astrologer_2a_1b_6c_2: But it should be in his <diary>. Just before his disappearance he gave me this <key>.
strings.astrologer_2a_1b_6c_3: It opens a metal <gate> in the northern part of the <Church Cellar>. Somewhere in there is where he kept his most important notes.
strings.astrologer_2a_1b_6c_4: Why didn't you take these notes?
strings.astrologer_2a_1b_6c_5: Oh I tried. But there's a secret to this key. I tried for months to figure out how it works.
strings.astrologer_2a_1b_6c_6: Maybe it's just in my mind and the key opens nothing.
strings.astrologer_2a_1b_6c_8: Try to learn how the <Key> works at the <Study Table> in the <Church Cellar>.
strings.astrologer_2a_1b_6c_9: When you have his <Diary>, bring it to me and I'll try to find some information about the <Portal>.
strings.astrologer_2b_1: Not terribly clean. But every bone is in its place.
strings.astrologer_2b_2: Seems you have a talent for anatomy.
strings.astrologer_2b_3: The human body is so mysterious. Perhaps even more than the sun and stars.
strings.astrologer_2b_4: I believe one day you'll learn much about the human body and the soul. And then you will find yourself absolutely lost.
strings.astrologer_2b_5: Now as we are now partners in crime. What is it you want from me, my curious friend?
strings.astrologer_about_acid_1: Do you know where can I find any <Acid>?
strings.astrologer_about_acid_2: I gave up alchemy many years ago. It's really a dead end occupation. But I think I know where you can get some <Acid>.
strings.astrologer_about_acid_3: There should be an old woman in the swamp. She's definitely crazy. But in the distant past she sold chemical ingredients.
strings.astrologer_about_tools_1: Do you know where can I find some <Restoration Tools>?
strings.astrologer_about_tools_2: There we may have a problem, young man. <The Inquisition> destroyed them all. Fools! They believe that past can only bring harm and curses!
strings.astrologer_about_tools_3: But I think you might still be able to find some on the black market. Somebody with criminal connections could help you.
strings.astrologer_about_tools_4: I definitely know the right guy!
strings.astrologer_acid_1: Here's the <Acid>. I think there should be more than enough.
strings.astrologer_afterall: Ha ha. Hello, my young friend. What a bloody fine day it is today!
strings.astrologer_afterall_1: I haven't felt so alive in years.
strings.astrologer_afterall_2: My daughter is a bit upset about all that love stuff.
strings.astrologer_afterall_4: I've decided to help my friend repair his lighthouse.
strings.astrologer_afterall_5: It's a lot of work. But I'll be glad to be helpful!
strings.astrologer_books_1: I didn't read your book. But everybody at the university was excited.
strings.astrologer_books_1_1: Perhaps a little too excited... They called it a breath of fresh air. — And now they want a sequel!
strings.astrologer_books_1_2: So we need to write another one.
strings.astrologer_books_1_3: By the way, if you'd like to write something, I'll be glad to buy it.
strings.astrologer_books_2: I don't know what you wrote. But my professorship has been fully restored — and I've even been promoted!
strings.astrologer_books_2_1: Ah, and best of all, the Dean signed the expeditions papers.
strings.astrologer_books_2_2: But we have a final problem. We need someone with <Aristocrat Papers> to accompany me.
strings.astrologer_books_2_3: It wouldn't normally be a problem to find someone. But considering the sensitivity of our situation...
strings.astrologer_books_2_4: It should really be you. Get yourself some <Aristocrat Papers>. I'm depending on you.
strings.astrologer_charm_10: Do you promise to tell me where the a <Golden Angle> is, if I can reunite you with your daughter?
strings.astrologer_charm_2: My daughter. Where are they now?
strings.astrologer_charm_3: Esmeralda died many years ago. But her daughter is alive and well.
strings.astrologer_charm_4: I think you might even have heard about her. Her name is Ms Charm.
strings.astrologer_charm_5: Unbelievable! She's very talented! I saw her perform once.
strings.astrologer_charm_6: Oh, I'm afraid she'll never accept me. I left her mother before she was born... But I didn't know!
strings.astrologer_charm_7: I knew that it would break Esmeralda's heart. But it was all in the name of science!
strings.astrologer_charm_9: Young man. You must test these waters for me. Speak with her. Find out what my chances are.
strings.astrologer_charm_know_1: I think I've found a way you can earn your daughter's forgiveness.
strings.astrologer_charm_know_10: I've been there once. At a archeological expedition...
strings.astrologer_charm_know_11: It didn't end well... We accidentally blew up the <Northern Pass>. It wasn't our fault. The <Great Blast> interfered with our calculations.
strings.astrologer_charm_know_12: The Lord Commander threatened to kill me. We barely made it out alive.
strings.astrologer_charm_know_13: But many years have passed. I think we could arrange a new expedition, by order of the university.
strings.astrologer_charm_know_14: And then we might covertly release this young man.
strings.astrologer_charm_know_2: What can I do? I'm ready to do anything within my power — and beyond!
strings.astrologer_charm_know_3: There's one young man. Well, right now he's not exactly a man.
strings.astrologer_charm_know_4: Long story short, he's in danger. He's been imprisoned at the <Mountain Fort>.
strings.astrologer_charm_know_5: Your daughter wants to save him.
strings.astrologer_charm_know_7: Well, she said that she loves him. So if we... if you help her release him...
strings.astrologer_charm_know_8: It would be a good first step.
strings.astrologer_charm_know_9: Hmmm... Interesting. The fort is closed, and strictly guarded.
strings.astrologer_charm_no_1: Well... I told her I might know who her father is.
strings.astrologer_charm_no_3: Let's say she wasn't excited. She told me that you never tried to find her.
strings.astrologer_charm_no_6: Still..maybe I can somehow earn her forgiveness.
strings.astrologer_charm_no_7: If I find out anything, you'll be the first person to know.
strings.astrologer_charm_no_8: Oh, thank you young man! You're so kind!
strings.astrologer_diary_1: Great, great. How many important things there must be in this book. Amazing!
strings.astrologer_diary_2: I haven't felt so alive for a long time!
strings.astrologer_diary_3: So how can I open the <Portal> on <Witch Hill>?
strings.astrologer_diary_4: Let me see. You need to craft a <Spirit Laser>. But I don't know what a laser is, sorry...
strings.astrologer_diary_5: It should be crafted on the <Pedestal> in front of the portal. Hm...
strings.astrologer_diary_6: You need to craft it in two parts: an <Emitter> and a <Barrel>...
strings.astrologer_diary_7: And here we have 3 parts of the <Emitter>...
strings.astrologer_diary_8: A <Mirror of Pride>, an <Eternal Burning Coal> and a <Salty Fork>.
strings.astrologer_diary_9a_1: The second part of the book's text is covered with something sticky. I'll need to clean it off first.
strings.astrologer_diary_9a_2: I think I'll need some <Acid> and <Restoration Tools> to clean it.
strings.astrologer_diary_9a_3: There should be an old woman in the swamp. She's definitely mad. But in the distant past she once sold me chemical ingredients.
strings.astrologer_diary_9b: Where can I find that stuff?
strings.astrologer_diary_9b_1: He wrote that his friends believed that all these things could be found in <The Town>. Hm... I don't understand this, but he wrote that they were the soul of <The Town>.
strings.astrologer_diary_9b_2: It all sounds like a delusion to me. Magic — hah... what nonsense!
strings.astrologer_diary_9b_3: If I were you, I'd start with something you can see. First I'd check the <Pedestal> near the <Portal>.
strings.astrologer_diary_9b_4: Second, try to get to <The Town>. And find those items!
strings.astrologer_fix_mill_1: You're good at calculating angles stuff, right?
strings.astrologer_fix_mill_2: Oh... That sounds like a lot of work. I'm not so sure...
strings.astrologer_gold_2: Oh, well! This looks good! We'll be going on that expedition in no time!
strings.astrologer_items_1: You promised to tell me about the items I'm looking for.
strings.astrologer_items_10: I left it in a camp at the <Mountain Fort> with my other belongings. We left the camp in quite a hurry.
strings.astrologer_items_11: I think it should still be there. I doubt anyone would be brazen enough to break the seal of the <Royal University>.
strings.astrologer_items_2: I think I saw a <Necklace> with a blood sapphire. Esmeralda has one.
strings.astrologer_items_3: She found it lying on the ground, the morning after <Great Blast>.
strings.astrologer_items_4: I think she gave it to her daughter.
strings.astrologer_items_5: Maybe... maybe... Lots of rocks and other strange things were scattered around <Witch Hill> after that blast.
strings.astrologer_items_6: There were a lot of fires, a lot of destruction. I never saw my friend the <Graveyard Keeper> after that night.
strings.astrologer_items_7: But like Esmeralda, I found something strange — a measuring instrument. Near an archaeological dig site.
strings.astrologer_items_8: I think it may be your a <Golden Angle>.
strings.astrologer_last: We have papers from the Royal University.
strings.astrologer_last_1: We need to go to the old archaeological site.
strings.astrologer_last_10: It's alright I see only your inner beauty.
strings.astrologer_last_12: How can we get this cage open?
strings.astrologer_last_13: I have some lockpicks... I had a pretty rough youth.
strings.astrologer_last_14: We need to hide him at the <Old Archaeological Camp>.
strings.astrologer_last_15: Then we can get him out in one of the crates.
strings.astrologer_last_17: Ms Charm I have so many...
strings.astrologer_last_19: You've ruined everything! My son should have been a glorious knight. And now we don't need them anymore. So he decided to become a writer!
strings.astrologer_last_2: You may pass. But I'll have to let <Lord Commander> know you're here.
strings.astrologer_last_21: You're the one who blow up the passage... It's all your fault!
strings.astrologer_last_22: It wasn't my fault...We need new calculation after the <Great Blast>...
strings.astrologer_last_23: I think our <Golden Angle> wasn't that accurate... Sooo..
strings.astrologer_last_24: Ah, excuses. I know that something's going on. First this creature! Then your expedition...
strings.astrologer_last_25: You are all traitors, and you're probably a witch.
strings.astrologer_last_26: I'm with the <Inquisition>... I'm under cover!
strings.astrologer_last_27: You can kill me if you want! But release my daughter!
strings.astrologer_last_28: Father! I cannot leave without my father — and this young man!
strings.astrologer_last_3: Oh, there's no need, brave soldier. Let him sleep. We'll talk with him in the morning.
strings.astrologer_last_31: Ha ha, <The Court>. I'm the <King's> uncle.
strings.astrologer_last_33: Oh, shut up. I'll admit Vagner is, of course, is a great disappointment. But this is too much even for him!
strings.astrologer_last_34: I can prove it! I have birthmark just to the left of... my tail.
strings.astrologer_last_35: It should be somewhere around here, under my fur...
strings.astrologer_last_36: You know... I'm just gonna kill you all... No bodies... No problem...
strings.astrologer_last_37: I can help with the bodies, <Lord Commander>!
strings.astrologer_last_38: So it seems that this is the end. Forgive me, daughter. I cannot change what I did. But right now you are everything to me...
strings.astrologer_last_39: Father. This is the best day of my life. I've found my father, and my love.
strings.astrologer_last_4: Thank you both for helping me...
strings.astrologer_last_42: Yes, father — it's me. You nearly killed your own child! But I forgive you!
strings.astrologer_last_43: I have a deal to offer you. I'll become a Knight, but you have to let everyone else go!
strings.astrologer_last_44: That sounds fair... As for you, old man... We're not done...
strings.astrologer_last_45: But for now all of you can go.
strings.astrologer_last_47: Don't be sad. We'll be together soon!
strings.astrologer_last_48: Here, take this <Necklace>. I think it belongs to you.
strings.astrologer_last_49: I bought it using my father's name. I wanted to make it a surprise...
strings.astrologer_last_50: Everything seems to have ended up well.
strings.astrologer_last_51: I don't know, my young friend. I think we still have a lot of problems.
strings.astrologer_last_52: Vagner is alive and safe... Come along father, I want you to show me where you live.
strings.astrologer_last_53: And you. Thank you for everything. Is there anything I can do for you?
strings.astrologer_last_54: That <Necklace>... I need it to get back home to my love.
strings.astrologer_last_55: Hm... Seems like it's already helped me... I hope it helps you now too. Here, take it.
strings.astrologer_last_56: Oh, young man. I managed to get <A golden angle> from my old stuff after all. It's yours as we agreed.
strings.astrologer_last_59: But I'm as smart as you are, ha ha!!
strings.astrologer_last_6: He should be in a camp near the road.
strings.astrologer_last_7: It looks like the soldiers are sleeping...
strings.astrologer_last_9: Oh. Ms Charm, you shouldn't see me like this...
strings.astrologer_necronamicon_1: If I'm right, you used to work at the University...
strings.astrologer_necronamicon_2: Yes. That were the good old days. I think my life might have even had meaning...
strings.astrologer_necronamicon_3: But now... nothing moves me anymore. I've known enough to know I'll never know enough.
strings.astrologer_necronamicon_4: And besides all that, <The Inquisition's> rules gave become untenable. So in the end, I quit.
strings.astrologer_necronamicon_5: Maybe you still have some connections there? I need one book — the <Necronomicon>.
strings.astrologer_necronamicon_6: Oh, young man — I took that book with me! Nobody looks after that "magic" garbage.
strings.astrologer_necronamicon_7: So I decided to give it to my friend. He can't read, but he likes the pictures.
strings.astrologer_necronamicon_9: Right here, ha ha. He works as a <Lighthouse Keeper>.
strings.astrologer_second_diary: Seems that I have everything I need to get these pages apart.
strings.astrologer_second_diary_10: "When I was..." Wait a second — there's something else on this page.
strings.astrologer_second_diary_11: With my friend... near the lighthouse... I should tell him... Esmeralda is pregnant... his child...
strings.astrologer_second_diary_12: I think I'm going to have a stroke right now.... I have a child... I may have a child...
strings.astrologer_second_diary_15: You were talking about a <Necklace> and a <Golden Angle>.
strings.astrologer_second_diary_16: Yes... Yes! It's all connected. How strange! I might have a child. Of course, by now he or she must be around 25. But still.
strings.astrologer_second_diary_17: We were talking about a <Necklace> and a <Golden Angle>!
strings.astrologer_second_diary_18: Young man, you must help me! You must! Yes, yes, I know exactly where you can find a <Golden Angle>.
strings.astrologer_second_diary_19: I'll tell you everything. Just help me find out what happened to Esmeralda and her... our child!
strings.astrologer_second_diary_21: How did you people manage things before...
strings.astrologer_second_diary_22: Let's think where to start.. Esmeralda arrived here with a gypsy caravan through the <Northern Pass>.
strings.astrologer_second_diary_23: They can't leave because the pass collapsed. I hear that they still have a small camp near the <Mountain Fort> north of <The Village>.
strings.astrologer_second_diary_24: You should go there and talk with her brother. He should to be the <Gypsy Baron> now, after his father's death.
strings.astrologer_second_diary_3: The young are always in a hurry. But where are you going? There's nothing up ahead.
strings.astrologer_second_diary_5: Almost... Haha... I've still got it!
strings.astrologer_second_diary_7: Here we have 3 parts of the <Barrel>...
strings.astrologer_second_diary_8: A <Necklace> with a sapphire, a <Golden Angle> and an <Endless Notebook>.
strings.astrologer_second_diary_9: Hmm... I believe I know where to get a <Necklace> and a <Golden Angle>.
strings.astrologer_silver_2: Nice title page! Ok, come by next week and I'll tell you what happened.
strings.astrologer_title_2: I'll send for my daughter. She will join us near the fort.
strings.astrologer_tools_1: I hope these are the right tools.
strings.astrologer_tools_2: Not the best I've ever worked with. But I think they'll do.
strings.b_empty_d: A couple words without any real inspiration. It still works somehow...
strings.b_faith_d: A number of very touching words. Your flock will produce more (faith).
strings.b_faith_money_d: A touching story about the church's needs. Earns extra (faith) and donations.
strings.b_grat_points_incr_d: Let us pray for the contentment of souls. Increases the amount of (gratitude points) received from souls (+10%)
strings.b_money_d: Piteous word about the church's needs. You can count on extra donations!
strings.b_pen_d: These words will boost your inspiration!
strings.b_plant_d: A few words about the importance of agriculture, fertilization, and personal hygiene.
strings.b_shield_d: True words that will make you tough.
strings.b_sin_shard_d: Let us pray for the thorough cleansing of souls. Increases the number of shards of sins received from the successful treatment of souls (x2)
strings.b_sins_d: It's about sin and forgiveness. Based on a couple of stories from your youth.
strings.b_skull_d: (Advertising) All deceased are welcome in your graveyard!
strings.b_souls_d: Let's pray for the repose of souls. The more (gratitude_points) you got, the more faith you'll get
strings.b_star_d: True words about the blessedness of hard work.
strings.b_sword_d: True words that fill you with fury.
strings.b_village_d: For those who earn their keep in honest trade. This will give you a <Commercial Blessing> which can improve one vendor.
strings.bank_check_d: You've never seen so many zeros! Unfortunately, the checks are personalized.
strings.barman_after_pallets_10: Because it's fun! <Events> are the best way to entertain people and earn money!
strings.barman_after_pallets_11: Look, one good event can bring in more revenue than a couple of weeks without events.
strings.barman_after_pallets_12: The thing is, you can sell a lot of food and alcohol at an event!
strings.barman_after_pallets_14: The food needs to be suitable for the event. You can sell inappropriate food too, but...
strings.barman_after_pallets_15: You'll have to price it low, and even then people won't buy much.
strings.barman_after_pallets_16: So how can I start an <event>?
strings.barman_after_pallets_17: It's easy! Though you'll need <reputation stars>, <advertising flyers>, and a little faith in yourself.
strings.barman_after_pallets_2: I put the beer on the pallets like you asked.
strings.barman_after_pallets_3: Good work! You have any questions?
strings.barman_after_pallets_4: What's the <bar with the stars> beside you?
strings.barman_after_pallets_5: It's our <reputation bar>. It fills up with every drop of alcohol you sell.
strings.barman_after_pallets_6: Completely filling the bar will give you a <reputation star>.
strings.barman_after_pallets_8: It's simple! We need reputation stars to hold <events> at the tavern.
strings.barman_after_pallets_9: Why do we want to have <events>?
strings.barman_greeter_1: You know what? Our tavern definitely needs a <greeter>.
strings.barman_greeter_2: Just put one in front of the building and enjoy Horadric's envy.
strings.barman_greeter_placed_2: Our tavern has the best greeter in the world. And he's undead just like you!
strings.barman_greeter_placed_3: An excellent choice! The undead make the most reliable helpers.
strings.barman_intro_11: <Customers> buy alcohol and enjoy life. But they like quality taverns!
strings.barman_intro_12: So: the higher the <tavern's quality>, the more customers you get. And the more customers, the more money!
strings.barman_intro_13: If you have other questions, you're welcome to ask.
strings.barman_intro_14: Oh, I'm already looking forward to the stupors, the wild screams, the drunken fights... It's marvelous!
strings.barman_intro_15_a_1: It's a <reputation bar>. It fills with every drop of alcohol you sell.
strings.barman_intro_15_a_10: Food must be suitable for the event. Inappropriate food can be sold too but...
strings.barman_intro_15_a_11: But for a lower price and in much smaller quantities.
strings.barman_intro_15_a_12: And how can I start an <event>?
strings.barman_intro_15_a_13: Easy! Though you need <reputation stars>, <advertising flyers>, and a little faith in yourself.
strings.barman_intro_15_a_2: Completely filling the bar will give you a <reputation star>.
strings.barman_intro_15_a_4: It's simple! Reputation stars are needed for holding <events> at the tavern.
strings.barman_intro_15_a_5: Why do we want to have <events>?
strings.barman_intro_15_a_6: Because it's fun! <Events> are the best way to entertain people and earn money!
strings.barman_intro_15_a_7: Look, a good event can bring in more revenue than a couple of weeks without events.
strings.barman_intro_15_a_8: The thing is, you can sell a lot of food and alcohol during an event!
strings.barman_intro_2: Oh, It'll be a such pleasure to work with you...
strings.barman_intro_3: No salary, no insurance, no vacations? Never! I'm on strike!
strings.barman_intro_5: Okay, now you're alone. Since you're such a skilled bartender, could you tell me some details?
strings.barman_intro_6: Of course! A tavern is like a... a... defenseless flower. Yes!
strings.barman_intro_7: Your duty to care for it and develop it like your child! So you must remember the following:
strings.barman_intro_8: There're a kitchen and a storage area in the <cellar>. Alcohol is stored on <pallets>.
strings.barman_intro_9: We sell alcohol from pallets around the clock. We need to make sure it doesn't run out.
strings.barman_intro_new_11: <Customers> like to buy alcohol and enjoy themselves. But they like quality taverns!
strings.barman_intro_new_12: So: the higher the <tavern's quality>, the more customers you get. And the more customers, the more money!
strings.barman_intro_new_13: Oh, I'm already looking forward to the stupors, the wild screams, the drunken fights... It'll be marvelous!
strings.barman_intro_new_14: For starters, put some <beer> on the <pallets>.
strings.barman_intro_new_2: Oh, it'll be a such pleasure to work with you...
strings.barman_intro_new_3: No salary, no insurance, no vacations? Never! I'm on strike!
strings.barman_intro_new_5: I guess he's gone. Since you're such a skilled bartender, could you tell me a little about it?
strings.barman_intro_new_6: Of course! A tavern is like a... a... defenseless flower. Yes!
strings.barman_intro_new_7: Your duty is to care for it, and nurture it like your own child! So you must remember this:
strings.barman_intro_new_8: There're a kitchen and a storage area in the <cellar>. Alcohol is stored on <pallets>.
strings.barman_intro_new_9: We sell alcohol off the pallets around the clock. We need to make sure it doesn't run out.
strings.barman_tavern_tutorial_2: The <reputation bar> fills with every drop of alcohol you sell.
strings.battle_horseshoes_d: Hardened and studded. All the better for your kicking pleasure!
strings.before_20cs_1: We'll use your handkerchief. It's the only thing we have... from our world.
strings.before_20cs_2: Maybe the machine will show us what really happened.
strings.before_20cs_3: I still don't understand, my love...
strings.before_20cs_4: I hoped so much that you'd be able to tell me everything...
strings.before_20cs_5: Is this another world? Is it an illusion? Or is it life after death?
strings.before_20cs_7: We must take this final chance to learn the truth.
strings.better_save_soul_popup_window:
Thank you for purchasing DLC "Better Save Soul"!
Additional content will be available when you will open the Church and repair the corpse hatch. The Donkey will deliver something special.
We hope that you will like the new story and new mechanics.
strings.big_tree_hint: I wonder how many logs I could chop from this big tree... If only I never got tired and I was super strong.
strings.big_tree_hint_wout_dlc: Only undead workers can cut down this tree.
strings.bishop_1_0: Dear me, I'm so tired. Why? Why do I have to come here every week?!
strings.bishop_1_1: Oh dear, the new Keeper! Hmm... We've been expecting him for 30 years, but he pretends there's nothing wrong!
strings.bishop_1_10: It's part of my duty. The unpleasant part. It's kind of an old tradition.
strings.bishop_1_11: I don't know much about all the traditions and rituals.
strings.bishop_1_12: I'm just here to represent His might and glory! Ha ha!
strings.bishop_1_13: I have one tiny question. What is this <Burial Certificate>?
strings.bishop_1_2: I'm sorry to have to tell you this, but your <graveyard> is a mess.
strings.bishop_1_3: There is no way I'm promoting you to <Cleric> until you fix it!
strings.bishop_1_4: As soon as your graveyard quality is at least (wskull)<5>, I'll be pleased to promote you.
strings.bishop_1_5: You look like a spiritual leader! And I'm a good judge of character. Ha ha!
strings.bishop_1_6: I'm good at everything. That's why I was chosen... to represent His will... Ha ha.
strings.bishop_1_7: Your predecessor used to keep his stuff in a trunk somewhere here. You should check it.
strings.bishop_1_8: I'll come by again next week. In fact, I come here every (d6).
strings.bishop_1_81: Maybe I'm not dreaming. Did I eat something? ...
strings.bishop_1_82: Oh, he's waiting... What should I say...
strings.bishop_1_9: Why is it you come here?
strings.bishop_2_11a: I need to go home! There's a talking skull! He forced me to butcher a corpse!
strings.bishop_2_1a: I'm not the Keeper. I was going home from work...
strings.bishop_2_1a_1: Ha ha, a fine joke. I'm a humorist myself. Here's one.
strings.bishop_2_1b: How can I fix the graveyard?
strings.bishop_2_1b_1: Just repair all the graves. It wouldn't take me even an hour. But it's your job.
strings.bishop_2_1b_2: If you run out of <Repair Kits> while fixing the <Graveyard>, you can always craft new ones.
strings.bishop_2_1e_0: Can you tell me more about the <Burial Certificate>?
strings.bishop_2_1e_1: It is your payment for laying our brethren to rest.
strings.bishop_2_1e_2: It's all part of an ancient contract between <The Town> and <The Village>.
strings.bishop_2_1e_3: As soon as a body has been laid to rest, you can trade its <Burial Certificate> for <Money> at the village <Tavern>.
strings.bishop_2_1e_4: Oh god. This seems too complicated to be a dream...
strings.bishop_2_1e_4a_1: Oh. <The Town> is the heart of our glorious land! The Palace, the Cathedral — everything is there!
strings.bishop_2_1e_4a_2: You should see it for yourself. Hm... But in those clothes? That would be rather funny, ha ha.
strings.bishop_2_1e_4a_3: How can I get to <The Town>?
strings.bishop_2_1e_4a_4: It's not far from <The Village>. Just head south from the <Tavern>.
strings.bishop_2_1e_4a_5: And of course, like anyone else from the <Village>, you'll need a <Town Pass> to get through customs.
strings.bishop_2_1e_4b_1: Just go east from the graveyard gate, along the old stone road.
strings.bishop_2_1e_4e_1: How can I get a <Town Pass>?
strings.bishop_2_1e_4e_2: Oh, that's simple, you just need to have been born in <The Town>.
strings.bishop_2_1e_4e_3: You can also buy citizenship. But it's expensive.
strings.bishop_2_1e_4f_1: Just upgrade this poor church into a cathedral. That should take you about a century or so. Ha ha.
strings.bishop_3_1: I was definitely right about you.
strings.bishop_3_13: May the force be with you!
strings.bishop_3_14: Ha ha! Not too bad, but my sermons are much better!
strings.bishop_3_15: You should really prepare for your next ceremony.
strings.bishop_3_16: I think the last Prior kept some <Books> with some wonderful words in the <Church Library>.
strings.bishop_3_17: You'll probably find some weird stuff in there too. One of the Keepers was engaged in scientific research, ha ha. You can throw all that stuff out.
strings.bishop_3_18: I'll spread word about your next ceremony. Maybe next week someone will show up.
strings.bishop_3_19: By the way, as Prior, it's now your duty to perform a weekly ceremony on (d6). I can sell you some useful accessories for it. Ha ha.
strings.bishop_3_2: I hereby pronounce you official <Keeper> of this holy place, and <Prior> of this church.
strings.bishop_3_20: Also I have a small task for you. Just talk to me when you're ready.
strings.bishop_3_21: Ach, I have to get out of here. The air is so dry! My skin can't take it for long...
strings.bishop_3_4: Ha ha. It'll be a great honor for you to have me present at your first ceremony!
strings.bishop_3_5: So, just stand at the pulpit and speak <The Words>!
strings.bishop_3_7: <The Words>. Ha ha, actually you can just say whatever you want.
strings.bishop_3_8: You know, this place isn't so bad. Put up some extra decorations, some nice candles, music, incense, get all oiled up for a nice massa...
strings.bishop_3_9: Long story short, all this stuff will help you to get more <Faith>! And <Faith> is power!
strings.bishop_4_1: As you are a <Cleric> now, you should be involved in our blessed activities.
strings.bishop_4_2: I've decided to open a soup kitchen for the poor near the Cathedral.
strings.bishop_4_3: It'll help me improve my image. Apparently when they're hungry, my good looks stand out more. Ha ha.
strings.bishop_4_4: So I need a lot of cheap bowls. And it seems you have <Clay Deposits> just in front of your church.
strings.bishop_4_5: Make some bowls for me, and I'll give you a <Cleric's Beginner's Guide>. It will give you your first few (b) to start with.
strings.bishop_4_6: Also I'll gladly buy any bread you have for the soup kitchen. For a special price, of course. I am, after all, representing His will.
strings.bishop_5_10: And not just any fish — I need a <Quality Fish Fillet>. I believe you can find that kind of fish near the waterfall.
strings.bishop_5_10_OLD: And not just any fish — I need <Red Fish Fillet>. I believe you can find that kind of fish near the waterfall.
strings.bishop_5_11: Your mean <The Town> is starving right now?
strings.bishop_5_12: No. I can't eat meat. And as for the fish from the town harbor... well, no thank you. Not with that rotten <Ship of the Dead> half floating there.
strings.bishop_5_13: So you're my only hope. I think I've started losing my hair, on account of my bad diet.
strings.bishop_5_2: Whew, they're ugly. But they'll be just perfect for the poor people.
strings.bishop_5_3: I am pleased to note you involvement in the business of the church!
strings.bishop_5_4: I might even consider upgrading your <Church> to a <Big Church>!
strings.bishop_5_5: That means more <Faith> and more <Money>.  With a <Big Church>, you'll be closer to God — and what's more important to me than holiness?
strings.bishop_5_6: But all of this is far in the future. First, everything here has to be as perfect as my haircut. Ha ha.
strings.bishop_5_7: And I mean both the <Church> inside and the <Graveyard> outside. Ha ha.
strings.bishop_5_8: I'll do my best to meet your high standards!
strings.bishop_5_9: Speaking of high standards, I'd be so pleased if you could provide me with some fish. It'll save me from starvation.
strings.bishop_6b_1: I hope the <Graveyard> is meeting the high standards of Your Holiness.
strings.bishop_6b_2: Yes. I'm no longer even disgusted to be here.
strings.bishop_6b_3: Now just maintain it at this level to upgrade the <Church>.
strings.bishop_6bc_4: By the way. I forget to mention that you'll need to get a <Building Permit> to perform any construction upon the royal lands.
strings.bishop_6bc_5: And as far as the permit is concerned, I'm afraid you're on your own. I try to avoid their soulless greedy bureaucracy at any cost.
strings.bishop_6c_1: The <Church> is shining bright, Your Holiness.
strings.bishop_6c_2: It's nothing compared to the <Town Cathedral>. But for a church it isn't half bad.
strings.bishop_6c_3: Just a couple steps left, and then we can upgrade this church.
strings.bishop_afterall_1: It finally rained in <The Town>. It didn't make any real difference, but now their faith in me is higher than ever before.
strings.bishop_afterall_2: So I'm going to take this opportunity to make reforms — to help the poor, and get rid of the Inquisition's cruelty.
strings.bishop_afterall_3: My brother has the same thoughts. We were born in a poor family, so their struggles are very personal to us.
strings.bishop_afterall_4: You're good man after all, Your Holiness!
strings.bishop_afterall_5: My kindness and greatness are vast indeed.
strings.bishop_afterall_6: Keep everything going smoothly... And we'll make <The Town> a better place.
strings.bishop_aristocrat_1: I had to sacrifice my entire family and ten years of my life to get mine...
strings.bishop_aristocrat_2: Yet you gain yours so simply. You truly are an extraordinary man!
strings.bishop_cathidral_1: Let me guess... I'll need a lot of (wskull) and a lot of (cross).
strings.bishop_cathidral_11: Wow! (wskull)800?! That sounds like too much!
strings.bishop_cathidral_12: Hm... Yes... You're probably right. Ok, we'll say (wskull)200.
strings.bishop_cathidral_2: What a fine, intelligent <Graveyard Keeper> you are!
strings.bishop_cathidral_3: Plus one for team "I was right about you"!
strings.bishop_cathidral_4: How many do I need exactly?
strings.bishop_cathidral_5: Let me see. You have 30, plus ten... Hm... hm...  carry the three, move the two...
strings.bishop_cathidral_7: And then let's double it for both sides...
strings.bishop_cathidral_80_1: Good! It's tall enough to see <The Town> walls.
strings.bishop_cathidral_80_10: Maybe you could talk to your friend Lord Inquisitor?
strings.bishop_cathidral_80_12: Come on, don't be shy. He likes you.
strings.bishop_cathidral_80_14: Ha ha! Great! So go get yourself some <Aristocrat Papers> and an <Accepted Invitation> from someone important!
strings.bishop_cathidral_80_2: And there is also no sign of relief for <The Town's> water shortage!
strings.bishop_cathidral_80_3: Perfect! Oh, I do love my job....
strings.bishop_cathidral_80_4: So you're going to need to be an <Aristocrat> now, so you can stand with me at the great ceremony as my peer.
strings.bishop_cathidral_80_5: I think we've been over this. No one will know except you...
strings.bishop_cathidral_80_7: We need someone who is close enough to the <Royal Court> to attend our ceremony!
strings.bishop_cathidral_80_8: So we're clear, right? You need to get some <Aristocrat Papers>!
strings.bishop_cathidral_80_9: Also, as I said, we need someone important at our Ceremony!  I couldn't find anybody...
strings.bishop_cathidral_cross_2: Except the silk for the benches. I bought that from my friend, <Merchant>.
strings.bishop_cathidral_cross_3: Ah those merchants. Personally I'd banish them from the kingdom — the whole lot of them!
strings.bishop_cathidral_cross_4: They are truly the distributors of sin! Merchants, actors, doctors...
strings.bishop_cathidral_cross_5: The Church already provides everything they offer — only holy and more righteous!
strings.bishop_cathidral_cross_6: All right, I've seen enough. I'd say this church is ready to become a <Cathedral>.
strings.bishop_cathidral_cross_7: But you still need to make a statue of me. As of now, that's your main priority!
strings.bishop_cathidral_skull_1: The graveyard is indeed well maintained. I can see all the love you've put into it!
strings.bishop_cathidral_skull_2: Have you had any problems with the <Inquisition>? Ghosts? Witches?
strings.bishop_cathidral_skull_4: You know... That was a silly question. You're not in an Inquisition cell, so everything must be all right!
strings.bishop_cathidral_skull_5: Why do we even build these stupid <Ships of the dead>? And all that talk about the walking dead. I'm sure they're just stories.
strings.bishop_cathidral_skull_6: Then the money could go to the church, not that stupid shipyard. Hmm... very interesting.
strings.bishop_final_ceremony_1: The <Keeper of the King's Kitchen> accepted the invitation.
strings.bishop_final_ceremony_10: It'll just be a regular ceremony.
strings.bishop_final_ceremony_11: No... I'm talking about my brother. Only now do I see how much I've missed him.
strings.bishop_final_ceremony_12: Dear flock . We are here to pray for water for <The Town>.
strings.bishop_final_ceremony_13: Yes. And also to pray for our families. Only family can help us survive this cruel world — even the most deadly drought!
strings.bishop_final_ceremony_14: So let's forget our... your old fights. And forgive each other!
strings.bishop_final_ceremony_16: Oh, yeah, sure. And pray for water!
strings.bishop_final_ceremony_18: I need to go apologize to my Mom...
strings.bishop_final_ceremony_19: It's gonna be coming down in buckets!
strings.bishop_final_ceremony_2: Great! Then let us begin the ceremony.
strings.bishop_final_ceremony_21: I am so happy for you!
strings.bishop_final_ceremony_22: No I'm the one who's happy! I'm so happy!
strings.bishop_final_ceremony_24: Our parents would be so proud.
strings.bishop_final_ceremony_25: Ok guys I should probably leave you alone.
strings.bishop_final_ceremony_26: Thank you, thank you so much. You're truly a great help.
strings.bishop_final_ceremony_27: Do you still need my mirror?
strings.bishop_final_ceremony_3: First, let us await our important guest.
strings.bishop_final_ceremony_30: You can take my fork as well.
strings.bishop_final_ceremony_31: Come. We have so much to discuss!
strings.bishop_final_ceremony_32: Sure... Let me tell you about my journey.
strings.bishop_final_ceremony_33: Meh... Better we discuss our future...
strings.bishop_final_ceremony_6: I'm here for the ceremony as the new <Keeper of the King's Kitchen>.
strings.bishop_final_ceremony_7: I have... I just...  I'm just happy for you.
strings.bishop_first_time_preaching: Don't talk to me, talk to the people!
strings.bishop_fish_done_1: I hope that didn't sound blasphemous. Ha ha...
strings.bishop_get_citezen_1: Good. It wasn't actually necessary, I suppose. Who would ever know about your citizenship except me? Ha ha...
strings.bishop_get_citezen_10: <The Town> is dying without water. And I shall save <The Town>!
strings.bishop_get_citezen_3: Think of it as a test — a test of your faith, my son!
strings.bishop_get_citezen_4: Do you even know how hard it is to find someone who reaches my high standards?
strings.bishop_get_citezen_5: Aaah... You don't know. But I know. Even my brother disappointed me...
strings.bishop_get_citezen_6: But that's a story too sad to be told.
strings.bishop_get_citezen_7: I need you to build a <Cathedral> here! A really tall one.
strings.bishop_get_citezen_8: You and I. We will perform a great ceremony in this <Cathedral>!
strings.bishop_get_citezen_9: We will pray for the <Vimur River> to be filled with water!
strings.bishop_left_msg: Ok, I left a message in the mailbox.
strings.bishop_magic_item_1: You Holiness, I believe you might have a <Mirror of Pride>?
strings.bishop_magic_item_2: I need it. In fact, my whole life depends on it.
strings.bishop_magic_item_3: Ah, my precious mirror... How many speeches have I rehearsed as I looked into it...
strings.bishop_magic_item_4: That mirror helped me understand how important appearances are to your career!
strings.bishop_magic_item_5: I'm glorious because of this mirror.
strings.bishop_magic_item_6: I've have it since my childhood.
strings.bishop_magic_item_7: From rags to riches... Ha ha... This mirror gave me the confidence to accomplish all my dreams.
strings.bishop_magic_item_8: Maybe at this point of my greatness, I don't even need it anymore... Who knows?
strings.bishop_magic_item_9: Maybe one day I'll give it to you... Once I don't need any more proof.
strings.bishop_new_church_1: I'm no fan of this modern architecture.
strings.bishop_new_church_11: Oh... Then I must have forgotten to mention it. No wonder — I have so many important things on my mind!
strings.bishop_new_church_12: Just show me your <Rightful Citizen> papers, and I'll gladly open the <Big Church>.
strings.bishop_new_church_2: There's far too much light in here for my taste.
strings.bishop_new_church_3: But our modern faithful citizens, they'll enjoy it.
strings.bishop_new_church_4: Mark my words, in ten years, some of them might even learn how to read.
strings.bishop_new_church_5: What a crazy time this is...
strings.bishop_new_church_7: By the way, I think you should make the donation box bigger. And speaking of donations...
strings.bishop_new_church_8: Are you aware that in order to perform a ceremony in the <Big Church> you'll need to be a <Rightful Citizen>?
strings.bishop_no_more_info: I've told you all you need to know, my son.
strings.bishop_statue_10: The second one is for the soup kitchen. That one should look like I care.
strings.bishop_statue_11: But I'm also thinking about something important.
strings.bishop_statue_13: And the third one we'll put right here in front of the church. Make that one look like I'm cool and welcoming everybody.
strings.bishop_statue_14: This task is of utmost importance! Put it topmost on your to-do list!
strings.bishop_statue_15: Without these statues, we can't upgrade this <Big Church> into a <Cathedral>!
strings.bishop_statue_3: Ah it's you... I was just looking around.
strings.bishop_statue_4: You know, some of these statues aren't half bad...
strings.bishop_statue_5: Can you make statue of me?
strings.bishop_statue_6: For your grave? Are you dying, Your Holiness?
strings.bishop_statue_7: No... No. I'm in perfect health!
strings.bishop_statue_8: It's just to help me spread my holy aura. — Oh, wait... I've got a brilliant idea!
strings.bishop_statue_9: I need three statues. One for my office. Make that one a bit taller, and looking like I'm thinking about something important.
strings.bishop_statue_ready_1: Your Holiness, I've finished your statues.
strings.bishop_statue_ready_2: I think the one for the graveyard is the best.
strings.bishop_statue_ready_3: Oh, they all look great. Do I really have such manly cheekbones?
strings.bishop_statue_ready_5: Let's put this one right here, in front of the main entrance.
strings.bishop_statue_ready_7: We can upgrade the church to a <Cathedral> now.
strings.bishop_statue_ready_8: Almost everything is ready for the <Cathedral>!
strings.bishop_town_cathidral_1: Why can't you perform this ceremony in <The Town> cathedral?
strings.bishop_town_cathidral_2: Well technically we don't have cathedral....
strings.bishop_town_cathidral_3: Our old cathedral's steeple collapsed during the <Great Blast>.  We haven't been able to rebuild it.
strings.bishop_town_cathidral_4: No new construction isn't allowed to be taller than the <King's Palace>.
strings.bishop_town_cathidral_5: But out here we can build a <Cathedral> with a proper steeple.
strings.blacksmith_1_1: Hey. What are you staring at?
strings.blacksmith_1_2: Nothing... just looking around. I think I'm the keeper of the local graveyard.
strings.blacksmith_1_3: May I ask who you are?
strings.blacksmith_1_4: Unfortunately I'm the local <Blacksmith>. My name is <Krezvold>.
strings.blacksmith_2_1a_1: I have a letter for you from <Horadric>.
strings.blacksmith_2_1a_2: A letter. Of course, one minute away, and he can't be bothered to come himself.
strings.blacksmith_2_1a_3: Heh, I guess old habits never die.
strings.blacksmith_2_1a_4: Thank you. Sorry for my nagging. It seems it's my new habit.
strings.blacksmith_2_1a_5: Hm, slimes again. Horadric has asked me to get rid of them.
strings.blacksmith_2_1a_6: I don't have the time for those pesky little green bastards. But maybe you can help.
strings.blacksmith_2_1a_7: Take this <Rusty Sword> and an Energy Potion. The sword is broken. But you can <Repair> it with a <Whetstone> on the <Grinder> right behind me.
strings.blacksmith_2_1a_71: You can keep the whetstone. Maybe you'll need it to repair your shovels sometime.
strings.blacksmith_2_1a_72: If you manage to kill them, bring me their remains and I'll spare you some materials.
strings.blacksmith_2_1a_8: They should be right up the other side of my house, near the puddles.
strings.blacksmith_2_1b: Ask him where to find <metal ore>.
strings.blacksmith_2_1b_1: You know what — I like to work with metal myself. Where can I find some ore?
strings.blacksmith_2_1b_2: You can find metal ore in swamp soil. There's a huge <Swamp> to the west, across the river.
strings.blacksmith_2_1b_3: I used to collect ore there, before the bridge collapsed.
strings.blacksmith_2_1e_01: And they hurt. Dreams aren't supposed to hurt...
strings.blacksmith_2_1e_1: Good job! Take this whetstone. Just sharpen your broken tools and they'll be as good as new!
strings.blacksmith_tp_1: The door is closed until I have (happy)80 with <Krezvold>.
strings.blessing_commerce_d: Can be sold to a vendor to increase his tier progression.
strings.book_of_receipts_d: 50 ways to cook ratatouille with vegetables and cats.
strings.book_ruined_1_d: You can still salvage some paper from it.
strings.box_closed: The <Royal Service Box> will start working once the <Church> opens again.
strings.buff_cleancut_d: A steady hand reduces the chances of making a surgical error.
strings.buff_fishing2_d: You don't let fish off the hook easily.
strings.buff_fishing_d: You have additional time to hook a fish.
strings.buff_hardwork_d: You spend less energy working with axes and pickaxes.
strings.buff_pen_d: You have a better chance to write something of good quality.
strings.buff_pot_berserk_d: You have deal a lot of damage but also lose (hp) over time.
strings.buff_pot_damage_d: You deal additional damage to monsters.
strings.buff_sins_d: More people come during the week to confess their sins.
strings.buff_skull_d: Donkey brings corpses with more (skull) and (rskull).
strings.buff_sleep_d: Energy regeneration during sleeping is increased.
strings.buff_star_d: You have a better chance to craft something of good quality.
strings.buff_survay_d: You get extra points when studying new items.
strings.buff_sword_d: You deal additional damage to monsters.
strings.buff_tired_d: You need to sleep or you'll keep losing energy.
strings.burning_is_not_available: We can do it only once a (d2)
strings.burning_is_not_available_at_all: I think there's no point if we can't burn any witches.
strings.cant_exhume: To exhume a body you need to remove the grave's fence and gravestone.
strings.captan_1_2a_1: I think I'm pretty lucky to be alive.
strings.captan_1_2a_2: That's a good answer. Now bring me a beer and we'll share your luck!
strings.captan_1_2b_1: I'm stuck here, far away from home. I don't think I'm that lucky.
strings.captan_1_2b_2: That's a shame! Luck is like a beautiful dame...
strings.captan_1_2b_3: Ha ha. It's lucky we have <Ms Charm> visiting our poor tavern every week.
strings.captan_1_2b_4: Now bring me a beer. Let's drink to the lovely <Ms Charm>.
strings.captan_1_2b_4a: Why I should buy you a drink?
strings.captan_1_2b_4b: What's your problem? Are you out of money?
strings.captan_1_2b_4b_a1: Ha ha. It's not about the money. It's about luck.
strings.captan_1_2b_4b_a2: I used to be one of the richest people in <The Town>. But now my luck is all gone, and I'm stuck out here.
strings.captan_1_2b_4b_b1: Ha ha. It's lucky we have <Ms Charm> visiting our poor tavern every week.
strings.captan_1_2b_4b_b3: Oh she's the greatest actress in <The Town>. All the men there go bananas when she starts singing.
strings.captan_1_2b_4b_b4: Even old sea wolves like me admire her!
strings.captan_1_2b_4b_b5: So why does she keep coming to visit this sh... hole in the wall?
strings.captan_1_2b_4b_b6: Maybe she loves me! Ha ha. No, I'm just kidding. I'm not that lucky.
strings.captan_1_2b_4b_b7: Honestly I don't know. You should ask her yourself. If you dare, of course.
strings.carpenter_tp_1: The door is closed until I have (happy)80 with the <Carpenter>.
strings.chain_about_old_keeper_2: Chain, do you know anything about my predecessors?
strings.chain_about_old_keeper_3: The other Keepers? Oh, yes. The second Keeper was just awful!
strings.chain_intro_1: You must be the new Graveyard Keeper.
strings.chain_intro_2: So I've been told. But how did you know?
strings.chain_intro_3: Oh. If you live as long as I have, you'll probably learn how to read people too.
strings.chain_intro_4: But where's my manners? I'm <Mrs. Chain>, Horadric's wife.
strings.chain_intro_5: Nice to meet you. I have a few questions about...
strings.chain_intro_6: Oh, oh. You better talk with my husband. He is in charge around here.
strings.chain_intro_7: He's not only the tavern keeper, but also the elected head of <The Village>.
strings.chain_intro_8: Besides he really does like to talk...
strings.chain_intro_9: All I can do is to sell you some recipes.
strings.chain_parfume_1: Miss Chain, could you give me a vial of your perfume?
strings.chain_parfume_2: It's good, isn't it? But I'm tired of it. I'm going to make a new one.
strings.chain_parfume_3: I still have a small vial of the old stuff. I could give it to you. But first I need a little help.
strings.chain_parfume_4: Take this food to my sister. She lives at the middle of <The Swamp>.
strings.chain_parfume_5: And on a way back, catch a dozen of frogs for me. I'll need them for the new perfume.
strings.church_budka_1_think: There is no one to make a confession.
strings.church_budka_2_think: There is no one to make a confession.
strings.church_pulpit_1_1: I need to become a <Cleric> first.
strings.church_pulpit_infobox: Prayer will be available again next (d6).
strings.clotho_about_old_keeper_2: Clotho, did you know any of the previous Keepers?
strings.clotho_about_old_keeper_3: Hmm, let me think, my sweet... I do remember one. I think he was the third.
strings.clotho_frog_1: I have a talking frog. It asked me to...
strings.clotho_frog_2: It was a little experiment that went wrong... Now they're much meatier, but as a side effect they started to talk.
strings.clotho_frog_3: I guess it's still worth it, though. But I wish they'd stop calling me their aunt. Now I feel guilty when I eat them.
strings.clotho_give_food_2: There's no such thing as a good apple. I hate apples...
strings.clotho_resipe_2: A bird friend told me that you have a garden. Is that true?
strings.clotho_resipe_3: Yes, I plant a few crops.
strings.clotho_resipe_4: Would you consider helping an old woman?
strings.clotho_resipe_5: All I ever do around here is help everybody! Ah, fine. What do you want me to bring you?
strings.clotho_resipe_6: Pumpkin! A silver-star pumpkin! And in return, I'll teach you how to make pumpkin soup!
strings.clotho_resipe_done_2: Great! Soup is the perfect dish. You just wait until all your teeth fall out — then you'll know!
strings.cognac_about_10: Okay, okay. After that I'll tell you... er... something cool and important!
strings.cognac_about_2: Oh yes! You just need to find and dig out an <old keg>!
strings.cognac_about_3: Could you er... tell me a bit more?
strings.cognac_about_4: It's the <old Keeper's>. We used to drink together all day long!
strings.cognac_about_6: Hm... Dig <piles of soil> between the Village and the Lighthouse!
strings.cognac_about_7: There's too little cognac to go around, so do it quietly!
strings.cognac_about_8: Why should I do it? Why?
strings.cognac_about_9: Sard! Because I can hardly dig with teeth!
strings.cory_after_grind: You've helped us so much, my dear friend! Wait for me here tomorrow!
strings.cory_intro_2: I'm the <Graveyard Keeper>. Nice to meet you.
strings.cory_intro_3: If you need some stone materials I'll be happy to help you.
strings.cory_intro_4: For wooden materials, you can visit my brother <Tress>.
strings.cory_nails_2: Dozens of perfectly straight nails! It's like magic!
strings.cory_tavern_building_3: Unfortunately, we can't take any more orders this year.
strings.cory_tavern_building_4: The <Royal Council> hired us to build a <barn>.
strings.cory_tavern_building_5: And it takes all year to build a barn?!
strings.cory_tavern_building_6: Naw, we could build a barn like that in three hours!
strings.cory_tavern_building_7: But the bureaucracy...  And our <suppliers> are lazy turtles!
strings.cory_tavern_building_8: There must be something I can do...
strings.cory_tavern_building_9a: I'm ready to pay you enough that you can stop working for the <Council>!
strings.cory_tavern_building_9a_1a: It's a deal. But on top of that, you'll build me a <tavern>.
strings.cory_tavern_building_9a_1a_1: Cool! <"Cory and brother"> goes back to work!
strings.cory_tavern_building_9b: I'll become your <supplier>. Then you can build that <barn> much quicker.
strings.cory_tavern_building_9b_1: After that, I'll pay you to build a new <tavern>.
strings.cory_tavern_building_9b_2: Hm... hm... hmm... It's a deal.
strings.cory_tavern_building_9b_3: Let me see... We need <12 simple iron parts> and <12 wooden planks>.
strings.cory_tavern_talking_2: We've finished, man. The <barn> is ready.
strings.cory_tavern_talking_3: Now we're just waiting for your (slv)50, and we'll start work on your <tavern>!
strings.cory_tavern_talking_4a_1: Cool! <"Cory and brother"> gets down to work!
strings.cory_tavern_talking_4b_4: Go take a nap. Your new establishment will be ready by dawn!
strings.cory_wooden_planks_2: I adore the smell of virgin wood!
strings.craft_pick_res_hint_garden: Pick a seed or a fertilizer
strings.cultist_3: I'm not so sure this was a good idea...
strings.cultist_4: Yeah... I think you might be right...
strings.cultist_leave_1: My life will never be the same...
strings.cultist_leave_3: Do we still need to go to church?
strings.cultist_leave_4: He's right! This town needs a change!
strings.customer_2: This is the best burning I've ever been to!
strings.d_Faith: You can call it faith, inspiration, self-confidence. Anyway it's as powerful as money.
strings.d_Iron: It's important to have a good iron level in your blood.
strings.dark_gold_cloa_d: Pulses with magic. Trying to put it on would be extremely reckless.
strings.death_emulsion_d: It tastes like ordinary milk. Mixed with gasoline and chili pepper.
strings.desc_donkey: A talking donkey. He delivers bodies. From a left-wing stable.
strings.desc_npc_actor: A handsome young man. Сalls himsef a poet.
strings.desc_npc_actress: There's something about this woman that you can't understand.
strings.desc_npc_astrologer: He's wise and tired of everything, even life.
strings.desc_npc_beatrice: An inquisitor, whose beauty is only matched by her mystique.
strings.desc_npc_beekeeper: Trades goods related to bees and honey production.
strings.desc_npc_bishop: His motto — pray, preach, and look like you won the lottery.
strings.desc_npc_blacksmith: A well-built man with a glorious mustache.
strings.desc_npc_captain: Looks just like a classic pirate. Someone ought to give him a parrot.
strings.desc_npc_cultist: He seems dangerous. You get why everybody calls him Snake.
strings.desc_npc_dig: A weird old man with red eyes. He speaks strange words.
strings.desc_npc_engineer: Mason. Trades in everything related to stone production.
strings.desc_npc_euric: Longs to be healed of earthly sins
strings.desc_npc_farmer: A gloomy man with work-weary hands.
strings.desc_npc_farmers son: A tough lad. Doesn't look so smart though.
strings.desc_npc_ghost: A spirit with a complicated perspective on life.
strings.desc_npc_ghost_priest: The former priest of the Ancient God, living his afterlife in the Dungeon.
strings.desc_npc_gypsy: A cunning man with a golden tooth.
strings.desc_npc_hunchback: Loyal servant of the Lord Commander's family.
strings.desc_npc_inquisitor: You definitely wouldn't want to be his enemy.
strings.desc_npc_marquis_teodoro_jr: Something quite painful and tragic is hidden within this young aristocrat.
strings.desc_npc_master_alarich: The old man's sickly paleness and incredible exhaustion make you feel awkward.
strings.desc_npc_merchant: He's always ready to do business. Except around dinner time.
strings.desc_npc_miller: Looks strong. Seems a kind soul.
strings.desc_npc_mrs chain: Beloved wife of the tavern keeper.
strings.desc_npc_potter: An intelligent man with a calm voice.
strings.desc_npc_refugee_1: A former aristocrat, sentenced to the fire and escaped from prison.
strings.desc_npc_refugee_coffin_maker: Looking at her inspires thoughts of a female-spider, awaiting careless male-flies.
strings.desc_npc_refugee_cook: An attractive and jovial young woman, with a tendency to play the victim.
strings.desc_npc_refugee_moneylender: A lovely and caring old man. Who tends to make everyone his debtors.
strings.desc_npc_refugee_tanner: An elderly woman with a tired, wrinkled face and large, sad eyes.
strings.desc_npc_shepherd: A one-eyed, one-legged, one-armed fellow. Seems a bit fierce.
strings.desc_npc_shepherds_wife: The Shepherd's good-natured and simple-minded spouse.
strings.desc_npc_tavern owner: Tavern owner and a head of the Village. Buys Burial Certificates.
strings.desc_npc_witch: An old witch with young eyes.
strings.desc_talking_skull: A talking skull. He suffers from amnesia.
strings.details_pile_d: Suspiciously reminiscent of a pile of common scrap.
strings.dig_1: Ding dong. Bing Bang Bong. Dig I am! Am I?
strings.dig_intro_10: The only things that matter are peace, and herbs, and nice, sweet things.
strings.dig_intro_12: Bring me some honey and I'll teach you how to make a cake!
strings.dig_intro_4: I'm just trying to stay positive.
strings.dig_intro_5: And I know what truly matters!
strings.dig_intro_7: Heh. Do you think he can understand?
strings.dig_intro_8: No, Dig. He won't. Because he can't see.
strings.dig_intro_9: Ok. — Then I'll tell him a sweet lie.
strings.dig_land_purchase_2: Dear cake, dear cake, let me take, let you bake...
strings.dig_land_purchase_3: Dig, you wouldn't mind if I bought some <land> in your name, right?
strings.dig_land_purchase_4: Dear cake, dear cake, let me take, let you bake...
strings.dig_land_purchase_5: I'm planning to build a <tavern> there.
strings.dig_land_purchase_6: Dear cake, dear cake, let me take, let you bake...
strings.dig_recipe_done_4: Just remember — a cake can never be too sweet!
strings.dig_recipe_done_5: Sweetness can help you see things from other points of view. So you can learn more...
strings.dlc_scene_10_rep_1: Where's the Master? Even Chain never kept me waiting this long, Krezvold.
strings.dlc_scene_10_rep_12: Hey guys, I don't get it. Who's dead?
strings.dlc_scene_10_rep_13: Alas! The priests of the Ancient God have killed him!
strings.dlc_scene_10_rep_14: Yes. But do not despair. For he is still with us!
strings.dlc_scene_10_rep_15: His pure soul ascended into the heavens and now he's become our New God!
strings.dlc_scene_10_rep_17: With his dying breath, he declared Jove his viceroy and your King!
strings.dlc_scene_10_rep_18: As for me, I'm his... er... his... Pontiff, yes! Pontiff Lucius!
strings.dlc_scene_10_rep_19: The New God?! The King?! Somebody pinch me...
strings.dlc_scene_10_rep_2: Maybe he's sick? What kind of sickness do messiahs usually get?
strings.dlc_scene_10_rep_20: But as we are a democratic monarchy here, it is you, my subjects, who must choose.
strings.dlc_scene_10_rep_21: Will we forgive those pagans who killed our father, our teacher, our beloved Master?
strings.dlc_scene_10_rep_24: Hey guys, I got it! Let's kill them all!
strings.dlc_scene_10_rep_25: Let it be so! I obey your will, my beloved subjects!
strings.dlc_scene_10_rep_26: So I, King Jove, declare a Holy War!
strings.dlc_scene_10_rep_6: Hey guys, I don't get it. We're waiting for somebody?
strings.dlc_scene_10_rep_7: Citizens! Unbearable sadness has befallen us. Our Master is dead!
strings.dlc_scene_11_rep_12: Aren't you coming, Horadric? Hmm... you're looking rather pale...
strings.dlc_scene_11_rep_13: Maybe it's because we burned down the village and slit two hundred throats?!
strings.dlc_scene_11_rep_14: Chain... what am I going to tell her? How can I look her in the eyes again?
strings.dlc_scene_11_rep_15: Oh, brother, you're having a meltdown... We both promised to serve the Master. It's his will.
strings.dlc_scene_11_rep_16: And a good soldier follows orders!
strings.dlc_scene_11_rep_17: But Krezvold... What if she's already been captured?
strings.dlc_scene_11_rep_18: Come on, the cowardly priestesses would be the first to escape to the swamps!
strings.dlc_scene_11_rep_19: Anyway, let's get moving. If nothing else... we'll need to find you a new chick.
strings.dlc_scene_11_rep_7: Well done! A whole minute faster than the chapel!
strings.dlc_scene_11_rep_8: Like they say, any fool can put out a fire, but starting one is a real art.
strings.dlc_scene_11_rep_9: Onward, men! In the name of King Jove and the New God!
strings.dlc_scene_12_rep_1: High priestesses... erm... please don't be upset, but...
strings.dlc_scene_12_rep_10: What?! This is all about love? Amazing! Unbelievable! Ha ha ha!
strings.dlc_scene_12_rep_11: Nevertheless, it's all in vain, Horadric. Chain was captured and is about to be executed.
strings.dlc_scene_12_rep_13: Digus, I ordered you to tuck away some golden apples from the Tree of Wisdom.
strings.dlc_scene_12_rep_14: I managed to hide three... And... I had to... eat... the other two...
