strings.snake_aple_3: You see, it can help you open the gate to the 11th level.
strings.snake_aple_4: I need you to go deeper. — And bring me a <Golden Apple>.
strings.snake_aple_5: That's the last thing I need for the ritual.
strings.snake_aple_get_1: Give it to me. I'll just lick it. I don't want to have too much knowledge...
strings.snake_aple_get_4b: No, I'm not into licking things.
strings.snake_aple_get_5: Ahhh. Now I understand what the last line of the ritual was about. The final ingredient...
strings.snake_aple_get_6: I finally know what the heart of the <Ancient Curse> is! I need a <Dark Heart>!
strings.snake_aple_get_7a: Inquisitor told me about them. I know how to extract one for you.
strings.snake_aple_get_7b_1: Hm... It's connected to the ancient curse somehow...
strings.snake_aple_get_7b_2: The last living specialist is in an Inquisition cell right now.
strings.snake_aple_get_7b_3: Just get close to the <Lord Inquisitor>. Try to find out more about it!
strings.snake_back_1: I need to go back and get that <Diary>!
strings.snake_back_10: Hm. Actually I could use your help.
strings.snake_back_11: Now that your immortal ass is here. I've decided that I don't want to die in this dungeon.
strings.snake_back_12a_1: Right up there. It was here even before the church. And nobody knows how deep it goes.
strings.snake_back_12a_2: In ancient times, they nailed heretics to the walls and scorched their legs. Before the Ancient Contract.
strings.snake_back_12b_1: I have my sources. So I always know where to find what I need.
strings.snake_back_12b_2: And at this point in my plan for retribution, a lot of the things I need are in that dungeon.
strings.snake_back_12b_3: First, I need a <Bucket of Blood>!
strings.snake_back_12b_5: You should be able to find them on one of the first levels. Where the pagans were tortured!
strings.snake_back_2: Wow, just wow. How did you do it?
strings.snake_back_3: I don't know. I just went back to my hut.
strings.snake_back_4: Great. I should be used to it — life gives me lemons all the time.
strings.snake_back_5: You're such a useless idiot, and yet you're immortal. That's totally not fair.
strings.snake_back_9: Let me write this down... Graveyard Keeper... can't die...
strings.snake_buisnes_1: I was told that you could get some... illegal stuff for me.
strings.snake_buisnes_2: If you heard that I could do something, then I probably can, but...
strings.snake_final_ritual_10: But I have another guess about who he's actually going to get! And I can't wait to see...
strings.snake_final_ritual_13: Today I get what I have wanted for my entire life.
strings.snake_final_ritual_16: I curse all of them! All of my anger — I sacrifice it for you!
strings.snake_final_ritual_18: Appear among us... I beg you!
strings.snake_final_ritual_2: Just a second. Wait here. I need to gather my followers.
strings.snake_final_ritual_22: Five guardsmen wait here! Four others, go wi...
strings.snake_final_ritual_27: Now I see it's you... I remember your face...
strings.snake_final_ritual_28: My son is dead! You are a creature of darkness! He was burned with his mother!
strings.snake_final_ritual_29: The house on Witch Hill. Mother threw me out of the window just before the beams collapsed!
strings.snake_final_ritual_3: How long do I need to wait...
strings.snake_final_ritual_30: You wove me a small horse out of vines... I called it <Flame>...
strings.snake_final_ritual_31: Son? Is it you? <Seth>, I am Your Father.
strings.snake_final_ritual_4: Sard. At least an a hour, maybe two.
strings.snake_final_ritual_41: Of course, go... Just... don't ruin the moment...
strings.snake_final_ritual_43: Wait... It seems that my ritual was a success after all. Here, my <Endless Notebook> is yours. I hope it'll help you to get back to your loved one.
strings.snake_final_ritual_45: And take my <Eternal Burning Coal>. I don't think I want to burn anybody anymore...
strings.snake_final_ritual_47_1: What we are going to do about the guardsmen? They saw us.
strings.snake_final_ritual_47_2: We need to get back to <The Town> first.
strings.snake_final_ritual_48: What a twist. But old Gerry knew.
strings.snake_final_ritual_49: Ha ha. Yorick lost the bet...
strings.snake_final_ritual_50: And I'm one step closer to my love...
strings.snake_final_ritual_6: What a stupid question, of course it's me.
strings.snake_final_ritual_7: I wouldn't miss this ceremony for the world... It should be hilarious.
strings.snake_final_ritual_8: Do you know what <Snake> is going to summon?
strings.snake_final_ritual_9: Sard yes. Actually, as his inner voice, I know who he would like to summon...
strings.snake_first_task_1: I don't like you. But your help will be taken into account.
strings.snake_first_task_2: As soon as everything's ready... all of you will behold his power!
strings.snake_give_key_2: At last! One step closer. Ok, you go first!
strings.snake_give_key_3: They'll see who's worthless. I'll wipe those smug looks off their faces!
strings.snake_give_key_5: I'm talking about all of them!
strings.snake_give_key_6: Everybody who lives in this cursed town. And everybody who thinks they're better than me! Just because I ...
strings.snake_give_key_7: Just because they have everything and I have nothing. But soon I'll have everything!
strings.snake_give_key_8: Whatever. Oh, I think I see what I'm looking for.
strings.snake_help_1: I'd like to help you. I've got a feeling I'll need you to return the favor...
strings.snake_help_10: Ok. I'll try. Back home we have a whole holiday for scary things. — Halloween.
strings.snake_help_11: I was good at these kinds of decorations. I'll figure something out.
strings.snake_help_12: Poor you... So we'll need this place to have (pntgrm)20.
strings.snake_help_3: First of all, we need to prepare for the ritual.
strings.snake_help_4: We need this place looking as scary as my old orphanage. Ha ha.
strings.snake_help_5: This place should have my followers trembling in terror...
strings.snake_help_6: But look who I'm talking to! Ha ha. Up in your church you've done some great decorating!
strings.snake_help_7: But this one should be darker, and without all the crosses. Crosses bring back bad memories for me.
strings.snake_help_8: Oh, oh. One other thing. For the ritual we'll need to have a fountain of blood.
strings.snake_help_9: Better make two, just to be sure.
strings.snake_help_done_1: So, what do you think of the place?
strings.snake_help_done_2: I'm impressed. Especially this pumpkin head...
strings.snake_help_done_3: What a sick mind you have...
strings.snake_help_done_4: Got the place — check. Now I just need some devoted followers!
strings.snake_help_done_5: Oh — and I also need a <Damask Sword>!
strings.snake_help_done_6: How's that going to help you?
strings.snake_help_done_7: You'll see. Just forge one, or buy one at the <Mountain Fort>.
strings.snake_instrument_1: I've got a job for you. I need you to find me some <Restoration Tools>.
strings.snake_instrument_2: A job. How cute. Who do you think you are, to hire me?
strings.snake_instrument_3: I've got silver. I'll pay you!
strings.snake_instrument_4: Nah... I've got no use for money right now.
strings.snake_instrument_5: If you help me achieving my life's goal, then maybe I'll think about helping you.
strings.snake_instrument_6: "Quid pro quo" as the villagers used to say.
strings.snake_instrument_ready_1: I need to ask a favor in return.
strings.snake_instrument_ready_2: Sure. Here's those <Restoration Tools> you were asking about.
strings.snake_instrument_ready_4: Yep. Had them when you asked me the first time.
strings.snake_intro_3: I'm the <Graveyard Keeper>. And <Prior> of this church.
strings.snake_intro_4: Mind your business. I have a dagger and I'll gladly use it!
strings.snake_items_1: Can you help me find something in <The Town>?
strings.snake_items_2: I can find anything. Just name it!
strings.snake_items_3: A <Mirror of Pride>, an <Eternal Burning Coal> and a <Salty Fork>.
strings.snake_items_4: That's some weird stuff... As you may have noticed, I'm working on a very important project right now.
strings.snake_items_5: So I'm a little short on time. But if you help me, maybe I'll help you!
strings.snake_items_give_1: Did you know where I can find the things I'm looking for?
strings.snake_items_give_2: It was very easy. I actually didn't search for them.
strings.snake_items_give_3: Just spent a evening in the pub at <The Town>. Everything was in the rumors...
strings.snake_items_give_4: The <Mirror of Pride> — everybody knows that the <Bishop> carries it everywhere.
strings.snake_items_give_5: People say the mirror helps him talk to his boss. Ha ha...
strings.snake_items_give_6: An <Eternal Burning Coal> — the <Inquisitor's> guard told me that's his master's most precious artifact.
strings.snake_items_give_7: He carries it around with him in his pocket. It's burning him all the time — that's why he's always so angry.
strings.snake_items_give_8: A <Salty Fork> — your friend the <Merchant> has one of those. It's weird. We normally just use spoons in <The Town>. Or our hands.
strings.snake_items_give_9: Apparently it helps him eat a lot...
strings.snake_magic_item_1: I noticed you have an <Endless Notebook>. I need it for something very important.
strings.snake_magic_item_2: I need it for a ritual of my own — to get back to my love.
strings.snake_magic_item_3: I understand you quite well. Perhaps even more than you can imagine.
strings.snake_magic_item_4: This book is only thing I have from my childhood. We weren't allowed to have our own possessions at the orphanage.
strings.snake_magic_item_5: When they pulled me from that burning house, I was gripping it in my hands. This book means a lot to me.
strings.snake_magic_item_6: This book's pages never end. I write down everything in this notebook. And a lot of pages were already filled up when I started.
strings.snake_magic_item_7: I always wonder what all those notes are about. How happy were the people who wrote them?
strings.snake_magic_item_8: You know what? If I succeed with my ritual, the notebook will be yours! I won't need it any more...
strings.snake_nacklase_1: You need to give Ms Charm back her money.
strings.snake_nacklase_2: I've spent the money. Bought some instructions for the key... So unless you know how to turn dust into gold...
strings.snake_nacklase_3: Then just find that necklace for her! Or can't you handle it?
strings.snake_nacklase_4: I'm <Snake>! I can find <everything> and everyone in <The Town>.
strings.snake_nacklase_5: And I know where this <Necklace> is! I just can't...
strings.snake_nacklase_6: You know it's really none of your business!
strings.snake_nacklase_7: I need to gain his trust... May be then he'll tell me more.
strings.snake_nacklase_again_1: You have a very good reputation in your business.
strings.snake_nacklase_again_10a_1: Once upon a time, he was a great warrior. He's the King's uncle. But of course it's easy to be great when you're born in a palace and you have a father who loves you!
strings.snake_nacklase_again_10a_2: If I were in his place, I'd definitely be King.
strings.snake_nacklase_again_10a_3: But he just became protector of the North Pass. And now there isn't even anything to protect! Ha ha!
strings.snake_nacklase_again_10b_1: The fort is north of <The Village>. It's huge. But nowadays it's falling apart.
strings.snake_nacklase_again_10b_2: The pass collapsed when I was child. It was the day after the <Great Blast>... It was the worst...
strings.snake_nacklase_again_10b_3: That's the day that my life took a bad turn...
strings.snake_nacklase_again_10c_1: Maybe I could help you get it back. I don't know how though... But we could brainstorm!
strings.snake_nacklase_again_10c_2: Brainstorm — is that some kind of spell? That could be quite useful...
strings.snake_nacklase_again_10c_3: No, we can just think about the problem together and...
strings.snake_nacklase_again_10c_4: Hm... actually you might be help.
strings.snake_nacklase_again_10c_5: You can try to get the <Necklace> with the help of the Lord's servant — the hunchback Koukol.
strings.snake_nacklase_again_10c_7: We had some kind of misunderstanding a while back. I sold him some ointment that <might> cure his hump.
strings.snake_nacklase_again_10c_8: And somehow he missed world <might>. So now it's up to you.
strings.snake_nacklase_again_10c_9: To be honest, I'm betting you'll fail. Either way, it's a win-win for me...
strings.snake_nacklase_again_2: I wonder what could have gone wrong with Ms Charm necklace?
strings.snake_nacklase_again_3: Heh... It's complicated. I'm the best there is at my job. I can find anything.
strings.snake_nacklase_again_4: Of course, that's a bit of a shady talent. So all these arrogant townspeople treat me like a garbage.
strings.snake_nacklase_again_5: But still they brings me their coins when they've got some trouble for me to sort out.
strings.snake_nacklase_again_6: Now that <Necklace> has my reputation on the line.
strings.snake_nacklase_again_7: You told me you know where the necklace is. So what's the hold up?
strings.snake_nacklase_again_8: Heh...It's not in town... It was purchased under orders from the old Lord Commander from the <Mountain Fort>.
strings.snake_nacklase_again_9: The <Necklace> has some kind of sentimental meaning for him. That's all I've been able to get so far.
strings.snake_necronomicon_10: You're a dangerous and unscrupulous rogue! Who else could perform this ritual, if not you?
strings.snake_necronomicon_11: You right! I hate it when someone's right...
strings.snake_necronomicon_12: But in this case it seems I could use a little help.
strings.snake_necronomicon_13: A favor for a favor, you know.
strings.snake_necronomicon_2: I'm hardly surprised...You are a man of extraordinary talents... Plus, you're immortal...
strings.snake_necronomicon_5: Wow. The ritual is more complicated than I expected.
strings.snake_necronomicon_6: Fear into the hearts... a fountain of blood...  a convergence of sin...
strings.snake_necronomicon_7: I'll never finish this ritual... I'll never get to see him!
strings.snake_necronomicon_8: Don't give up! I also have a difficult task too! I know what you're going through.
strings.snake_necronomicon_9: You just need to believe in yourself! Everything is in your hands!
strings.snake_sleep_1: Do you really need to say every time how refreshed you are?
strings.snake_sleep_10: What we are going to do?
strings.snake_sleep_11: We need to set a trap near <Witch Hill>, on the road to the graveyard!
strings.snake_sleep_12: We'll make it look like an accident.
strings.snake_sleep_13: I've already set up a distraction for him at the <Town Brothel>.
strings.snake_sleep_14: So we have a little time — but not much!
strings.snake_sleep_15: I'll be waiting you on <Witch Hill>. Right up from the road!
strings.snake_sleep_4: A well known vampire hunter is headed for your graveyard.
strings.snake_sleep_5: And he is going to kill me! And he'll probably burn down your church too.
strings.snake_sleep_6: Why is a vampire hunter after you?
strings.snake_sleep_7: It seems I got carried away showing off all my powers over life and death.
strings.snake_sleep_8: And one of my cultists turned out to be dumb and chatty.
strings.snake_sleep_9: It's so hard to find good help these days.
strings.snake_stone: Finally! Did you bring a wooden plank?
strings.snake_stone_1: Why should I have brought that?
strings.snake_stone_2: Because I asked you to bring one!
strings.snake_stone_4: Ok. Whatever. Just bring it! Hurry Up!
strings.snake_stone_ready_10: Everything is at stake! Just keep calm.
strings.snake_stone_ready_12: We'll only get one chance at this!
strings.snake_stone_ready_13: I love side-quests. Just in and out...
strings.snake_stone_ready_16: Great hunter. Ha! Undefeated warrior... Ha!
strings.snake_stone_ready_17: How nice of him to bring his medallion. Now we can get into the deepest part of the dungeon!
strings.snake_stone_ready_19: Get rid of the body! And clear the path.
strings.snake_stone_ready_2: You're lucky he's not here yet. Let's just wait.
strings.snake_stone_ready_20: Meet me near the dungeon entrance. I have a final task for you!
strings.snake_stone_ready_3: How long do we need to wait?
strings.snake_stone_ready_5: Are you sure that he's coming?
strings.snake_stone_ready_6: Yes! We just need to be patient.
strings.snake_stone_ready_7: No human can spend this much time in a brothel.
strings.snake_stone_ready_9: I'm really tired... And I need to eat something...
strings.snake_sword_10: Behold my power!!! Over life! And death!
strings.snake_sword_11: They are merely words to me!
strings.snake_sword_13: And that is why they lied you! But I will never lie you.
strings.snake_sword_14: After the dark ritual, our glorious conquest will commence!
strings.snake_sword_15: There he is! He's alive! He's immortal!
strings.snake_sword_17: Now go back home. And wait for my orders!
strings.snake_sword_18: I really like the way you did that whole death scene.
strings.snake_sword_2: And your timing is perfect! Just kidding — I've been following you for a while.
strings.snake_sword_21: Sure. I just need a little time for final preparations.
strings.snake_sword_3: And yes... I'm aware you have the sword.
strings.snake_sword_4: These are my followers. They have gathered here to behold my power!
strings.snake_sword_5: So I need to kill you with this sword. And then you shall return to life once more!
strings.snake_sword_6: Wow. How'd Snake do it... He must be so powerful... We should worship him!
strings.snake_teleports: I need to go back to Snake!
strings.soil_digging_1: Oh I can't take it! Where's my <cognac>?!
strings.soil_digging_11: Damn! See you in the cellar!
strings.soil_digging_13: Only landowners may dig in the <Village's land>!
strings.soil_digging_14: Moreover, everything in the Village's land is public property.
strings.soil_digging_16: Sorry, but you're too poor to bribe ME.
strings.soil_digging_2: Look, it's something metal and big.
strings.soil_digging_5: Your friend's? The one who buried the cognac?
strings.soil_digging_6: No, before him. A cool inventor and zombie creator.
strings.soil_digging_7: And believe me, this <machine> is much more useful than a simple keg of cognac!
strings.soil_digging_8: I'm confused. How many Keepers were there?
strings.soil_digging_9: This is a real treasure, dude! It could even help you return home!
strings.souls_euric_hatch_time: I guess I shouldn't bother him yet ...
strings.souls_keeper_builddesk_1: Looks like a good place to work on making my home cozy.
strings.souls_keeper_builddesk_2: Then maybe I can finally stop dreaming about this skull...
strings.souls_s_s10_1: Hey, Keeper. You're here for dinner or having a beer?
strings.souls_s_s10_2: I'm full, thank you. I ate recently.
strings.souls_s_s10_3: I'd like to ask a bit of advice.
strings.souls_s_s10_4: My question might sound a little bit strange...
strings.souls_s_s10_5: But who would you say is the most <prideful> among the villagers or local folk?
strings.souls_s_s10_6: You ask me,  everyone in this Village deserves each other.
strings.souls_s_s10_7: But I know what you're asking. I think you know this person very well.
strings.souls_s_s10_9: A handsome man with a beard.
strings.souls_s_s11_1: I found a person who can help us start the treatment.
strings.souls_s_s11_11: Then we'll need to do something to stoke his pride. In a good way, of course.
strings.souls_s_s11_12: Hmm... What if we say something glorious about him? Something poetic...
strings.souls_s_s11_3: But I still don't understand how to get the component we need.
strings.souls_s_s11_4: What do you know so far?
strings.souls_s_s11_5: We need to transform a shard of sin with the help of a highly sinful person.
strings.souls_s_s11_6: This "transformed shard" will be used in the coming treatment.
strings.souls_s_s11_7: Apparently, it isn't enough to simply walk up to the right person.
strings.souls_s_s11_8: We will probably need to trigger the person to express their sin.
strings.souls_s_s11_9: Which sin are we talking about here?
strings.souls_s_s12_1_14: There, I think it's ready. Nothing's ever perfect, of course...
strings.souls_s_s12_1_15: But I hope it's not too bad either.
strings.souls_s_s12_1_16: No, Vagner, it's perfect! You really are gifted!
strings.souls_s_s12_1_2: You see, I'd like you to write something for a certain person... something glorious.
strings.souls_s_s12_1_3: An Ode would do for that.
strings.souls_s_s12_1_4: You finally decide to melt the heart of your loved one?
strings.souls_s_s12_1_6: Ok, then who am I writing an Ode to?
strings.souls_s_s12_1_8: Mmm, interesting. True, he is quite a sensual person.
strings.souls_s_s12_2_1: Dear Vagner, how's your new life with your father going? What's the news?
strings.souls_s_s12_2_2: Everything is calm and peaceful in the Village, so don't worry about us.
strings.souls_s_s12_2_3: Could you do me a favor: I need you to write something glorious for <Bishop>.
strings.souls_s_s12_2_4: It would be great if you could assist us with this, since I'm sure your poetic talent still shines brightly, even in your circumstances.
strings.souls_s_s12_2_5: Hope you will help me. Sending you a friend-hug, Keeper.
strings.souls_s_s14_10: I return your hug with friendly warmth, Vagner.
strings.souls_s_s14_11: Send a little bit of help.
strings.souls_s_s14_13: Thank you, Vagner. That's just what I needed!
strings.souls_s_s14_2: I'm fine. Things certainly aren't the way they used to be, but I'm not complaining.
strings.souls_s_s14_3: I'm still in the training camp for beginners. It’s not easy for me physically, but I can take it.
strings.souls_s_s14_4: I'm enclosing an ode with this letter, I expect it should serve your purposes nicely.
strings.souls_s_s14_5: Hope it does what you need.
strings.souls_s_s14_6: I've got a request for you in return, Keeper.
strings.souls_s_s14_7: I presently find myself in rather a difficult financial situation. Could I count on you for a little help?
strings.souls_s_s14_8: I'd like to buy something nice for Ms. Charm when we get a chance to get to the market.
strings.souls_s_s14_9: Thank you for all that you've done for me!
strings.souls_s_s15_14: Seems to drift a world away.
strings.souls_s_s15_16: Drips from every word you say.
strings.souls_s_s15_17: What beautiful words, Keeper! Apparently, you truly do see the real me.
strings.souls_s_s15_18: And that means that you're on the path of God.
strings.souls_s_s15_3: I was wondering... When was the last time the people really showed their gratitude towards you?
strings.souls_s_s15_4: To be honest, it doesn't happen as often as I'd like...
strings.souls_s_s15_5: Well, I suppose it happens once or twice a week. Why do you ask?
strings.souls_s_s15_6: I have here some words written just for you.
strings.souls_s_s15_7: May I read it to you?
strings.souls_s_s15_8: Oh, this sounds interesting. What's could it be? Of course you may read it!
strings.souls_s_s16_1_10: Yes, I remember. Here, take it.
strings.souls_s_s16_1_11: Hm, it seems my map has changed...
strings.souls_s_s16_1_2: Nice! Let's go already. I can't wait for the first procedure.
strings.souls_s_s16_1_4: Yes. But I'm a little nervous.
strings.souls_s_s16_1_6: How do you feel? Is everything all right?
strings.souls_s_s16_1_7: I think I'm fine. My head is spinning and I'm tingly all over.
strings.souls_s_s16_1_9: Euric, do you remember what you promised to give me?
strings.souls_s_s17_1: Greetings, Keeper! I'm feeling much better today.
strings.souls_s_s17_10: He found a lovely place for me, right under the <Morgue>. It's thanks to him that I live down there.
strings.souls_s_s17_11: I'm very happy for you, Mr. Euric!
strings.souls_s_s17_12: It's also good to hear that the Keeper cares for people other than himself.
strings.souls_s_s17_13: If you ever visit the Village again, come visit us.
strings.souls_s_s17_14: These days, we're sorely lacking in refined company like yours.
strings.souls_s_s17_1_1: Hmmm... I never noticed before that there are hollow spaces in the stained glass...
strings.souls_s_s17_1_2_b: It looks like I can put something in there...

strings.souls_s_s4_ask_4_9: Oh, look, it says here there should be a workbench with some blueprints.
strings.souls_s_s5_1_1: Perfect! Let's take a look at this then...
strings.souls_s_s5_1_11: Thank you Smiler, that makes it a little clearer.
strings.souls_s_s5_1_2: Aha, yes, I've got it! It's a device for <extracting souls>.
strings.souls_s_s5_1_3: You put a corpse there, and it spins it around and somehow pulls the soul out.
strings.souls_s_s5_1_4: Fascinating. How could anyone ever come up with such a thing?
strings.souls_s_s5_1_5: Well, well, what's all this noise?
strings.souls_s_s5_1_6: Look, the Keeper repaired the <Soul Extractor>.
strings.souls_s_s5_1_7: Oh, well to be more precise, the soul flows out of the body by centrifugal force, through the bodily fibers and into a specially designed receiver.
strings.souls_s_s5_1_8: Which gathers the material into a homogenized substance.
strings.souls_s_s5_1_9: Yes, I meant something like that.
strings.souls_s_s5_2_1: My, that workbench... It fills me with a deep and primordial fear.
strings.souls_s_s5_2_10: What would you do without me?
strings.souls_s_s5_2_13: But it is impossible for a human to remain pure until the very end, ha ha!
strings.souls_s_s5_2_14: On the other hand, the soul itself, to simplify things... becomes impure inside our body.
strings.souls_s_s5_2_15: And generally, it is polluted through specific parts of a body.
strings.souls_s_s5_2_16: Fortunately for souls, this process is reversible, by inverting the forces applied by the organs.
strings.souls_s_s5_2_17: Maybe we shouldn't have released him at all? He could have just sat there forever.
strings.souls_s_s5_2_18: Don't take it personally. After all, he was on his own for a long time.
strings.souls_s_s5_2_2: There is indeed something... frightening about it.
strings.souls_s_s5_2_3: Hope we look better than that when our time comes, ha ha!
strings.souls_s_s5_2_5: The purpose of this workbench is to heal the soul.
strings.souls_s_s5_2_6: It requires a soul afflicted with sin, and organs of various qualities.
strings.souls_s_s5_2_8: As far as I understand it, they absorb the sins from the soul into themselves.
strings.souls_s_s5_2_9: It's written here that every sin requires its own organ. Although I can't say what that means precisely.
strings.souls_s_s5_3_1: Honestly, each construction seems more complicated than the last.
strings.souls_s_s5_3_10: Anyway, the main thing is that it helps you in your endeavor, right?
strings.souls_s_s5_3_2: And if anyone asked me what it was, I'd say it's a giant cauldron.
strings.souls_s_s5_3_3: If you ask me, the mechanism looks like a steam machine.
strings.souls_s_s5_3_4: Nonsense! What will you say next? That it should move of its own force? Or even more absurd — fly! Ha ha!
strings.souls_s_s5_3_6: So what's the point of this thing? What does it do?
strings.souls_s_s5_3_7: This contraption's purpose is "to see cleared souls off to the <Land of the Dead>, where they belong."
strings.souls_s_s5_3_8: "To mitigate the consequences of violating the <Ancient Contract>". Period. That's it.
strings.souls_s_s5_3_9: That's what Smiler was telling us about. It seems he's been playing straight with us.
strings.souls_s_s6_1: What's the matter? Why don't you go in?
strings.souls_s_s6_10: Well, I got here somehow, did I not? Perhaps somebody else might come through.
strings.souls_s_s6_11: Go now, and worry not — I'll be on guard.
strings.souls_s_s6_2: Have I suddenly grown weak, or is there something wrong with the hatch?
strings.souls_s_s6_4: It barely moves. Won't turn any further. Looks like it got rusty.
strings.souls_s_s6_5: What are we to do now? Will we have to break it open?
strings.souls_s_s6_6: Maybe we should lubricate the hatch? That would probably help.
strings.souls_s_s6_8: Very well then. You go get some oil, and I'll guard the hatch.
strings.souls_s_s6_9: I told you, nobody ever comes here...
strings.souls_s_s6_a_1: Are you sure you can use that to grease the hatch? It has an odor most peculiar.
strings.souls_s_s6_a_10: Really, you would help me settle in here?
strings.souls_s_s6_a_11: And if there's a little reward involved, things will go a lot more easily.
strings.souls_s_s6_a_12: Hmmm, tough times... It's a deal.
strings.souls_s_s6_a_18: Hm, a tooth. I wonder whose it is...
strings.souls_s_s6_a_19: Maybe Gerry knows? I should ask him.
strings.souls_s_s6_a_2: Yeah sure, it's just normal oil.
strings.souls_s_s6_a_3: No, surely not. Such a strong recollection... yet I cannot quite place...
strings.souls_s_s6_a_4: You see? There, the oil worked. The hatch is unstuck.
strings.souls_s_s6_a_5: Let's go already and see what's in there.
strings.souls_s_s6_a_6: Oh, fury of the Ancient, what a !@#$...
strings.souls_s_s6_a_7: Looks like a drunken giant was throwing his final farewell bash.
strings.souls_s_s6_a_9: It's ok, we can break down all the smashed furniture and replace it with new stuff.
strings.souls_s_s6_a_repaired_1: Euric, I've repaired everything that could be repaired.
strings.souls_s_s6_a_repaired_2: It's not as fine as a tavern, of course, but for temporary accommodation I suppose it will do.
strings.souls_s_s6_a_repaired_3: Here, a small reward, as we agreed.
strings.souls_s_s6_b_1_1: Gerry, do you know whose <tooth> this might be?
strings.souls_s_s6_b_1_10: So, all the broken bottles in that room are yours?
strings.souls_s_s6_b_1_12: All those... Well, it doesn't matter...
strings.souls_s_s6_b_1_3: Hey, wait, that's my tooth! Give it back to me or I'll bite you, you thief!
strings.souls_s_s6_b_1_4: Wait, stop, I found it nearby, that's why I came to find out who it belongs to.
strings.souls_s_s6_b_1_5: Look — it's all old and dusty.
strings.souls_s_s6_b_1_8: One time I had a toothache so bad, I didn't know what to do.
strings.souls_s_s6_b_1_9: Apparently, I had to get rid of it.
strings.souls_s_s6_b_2_1: Hey, Euric, you know what this is?
strings.souls_s_s6_b_2_2: As I understood, it's some sort of ancient artwork.
strings.souls_s_s6_b_2_3: There's something written about it here in the notes...
strings.souls_s_s6_b_2_4: Yes, here. It was dug up from behind the church, and was reformed from several pieces.
strings.souls_s_s6_b_2_6: It looks a stained glass window. It would be nice to put it in the church. It's quite pretty...
strings.souls_s_s6_b_2_7: I think so too. It looks like it belongs there. Plus it will free up more space down here.
strings.souls_s_s6_b_2_8: Sure, it's nice that you like it.
strings.souls_s_s6_b_2_9: But let's finish fixing my room first, then we can sort this thing out, all right?
strings.souls_s_s6_b_2_repaired_1: Well, you finished with my room. You can take that thing out of here.
strings.souls_s_s6_b_2_repaired_2: Will you help me carry it?
strings.souls_s_s6_b_2_repaired_3: I hope there's no one in the Church. I don't like religious people.
strings.souls_s_s6_b_2_repaired_4: No, there shouldn't be anybody today.
strings.souls_s_s6_b_2_repaired_5: Hm, it does look pretty, I must say.
strings.souls_s_s7_1: Hey, Keeper, why are you making noises here again?
strings.souls_s_s7_10: Although that <Keeper> wasn't so talkative with me, he did tell me about the devices here.
strings.souls_s_s7_11: Oh, a new addition to the workshop! Nice.
strings.souls_s_s7_12: Yes, the Keeper is working hard. While you're probably off biting your nails behind your hatch, aren't you?
strings.souls_s_s7_13: Maybe I am nailbiting. Want me to share? You don't have your own.
strings.souls_s_s7_2: I'm fixing up everything in this room, piece by piece.
strings.souls_s_s7_3: Oh, that is the <Soul Container>. Are familiar with how it works?
strings.souls_s_s7_4: Yeah, basically just like a pallet I think.
strings.souls_s_s7_5: Right, they are used to reduce the speed of soul corruption.
strings.souls_s_s7_6: By the way, there are more modern versions of these workbenches. Just saying.
strings.souls_s_s7_7: Thank you. How do you know so much about these machines?
strings.souls_s_s7_8: Haven't you guessed? It's quite simple: from one of your predecessors, of course.
strings.souls_s_s7_9: I can hear everything clearly, whether I am inside the box or out.
strings.souls_s_s8_10: And you want it, for nothing?
strings.souls_s_s8_12: Yes, you're right about that. Perhaps first you could assist me with a small problem?
strings.souls_s_s8_13: It would go a long way towards you receiving this insert.
strings.souls_s_s8_14: Assuming I agree, do you know how I can cure people? All these mechanisms were created only for healing souls.
strings.souls_s_s8_15: I already told you. The part of the book about the experiment on curing people was torn out.
strings.souls_s_s8_16: So ask your friend Smiler about it.
strings.souls_s_s8_17: It turns out that Euric doesn't know how to cure people.
strings.souls_s_s8_18: Maybe you know something about it?
strings.souls_s_s8_19: Not that much, actually. The <Keeper> preferred to keep this knowledge to himself. I can't help you very much.
strings.souls_s_s8_2: I should ask Smiler to tell me about this <Remote control> technology.
strings.souls_s_s8_20: But it's not all bad news!
strings.souls_s_s8_21: I know that you need to build a special interface, where you can place a person.
strings.souls_s_s8_22: Thank you! What would we do without you?
strings.souls_s_s8_3: Smiler, you know a lot of things. Is there anything you can tell me about <Remote control> technology?
strings.souls_s_s8_4: I remember the <Keeper> used it to maintain quite a tight schedule.
strings.souls_s_s8_5: The remarkable device is featured in the special insert in the <Keeper's Book>. Do you have the book?
strings.souls_s_s8_6: Euric has it. I guess I should go find him.
strings.souls_s_s8_9: Smiler said that your book has an insert in it...
strings.souls_s_s9_1: What should I do next? I'll probably need some special ingredients?
strings.souls_s_s9_10: I'll charge the shards and cure the person.
strings.souls_s_s9_11: But who are you planning to cure? Euric, I bet.
strings.souls_s_s9_14: After all, he knows everyone in the Village and surroundings. Maybe he could give me some advice.
strings.souls_s_s9_2: Absolutely, you'll need shards of sins, but not usual ones.
strings.souls_s_s9_3: They must be transformed by the presence of a person with quite strong signs of sin.
strings.souls_s_s9_4: So I'll have to find these special people?
strings.souls_s_s9_5: Yes, you'll have to seek out outstanding sinners, haha!
strings.souls_s_s9_7: Go straight for a person with a great sense of <pride>.
strings.souls_s_s9_8: Any suggestions who I should approach?
strings.souls_s_s9_9: Listen, you want me to do everything for you?
strings.souls_zone_key_d: With traces of gum still stuck on it. Why does Eirich need it?
strings.spectater_1: Meh... I've seen this show a bunch already...
strings.stick_d: Perfect for poking people and starting fires.
