strings.tr_qeuest_6_beekeeper_cs_1: Don't come any closer, or I'll attack!
strings.tr_qeuest_6_beekeeper_cs_2: Hey, why are you hiding there?
strings.tr_qeuest_6_beekeeper_cs_3: I'm not sure that I can trust you. Are you <Miller's friend>?
strings.tr_qeuest_6_beekeeper_cs_4: Not really. We're just business colleagues.
strings.tr_qeuest_6_beekeeper_cs_5: Good. <Miller> is my sworn enemy, and I'm here to learn his <sinister plan>.
strings.tr_qeuest_6_beekeeper_cs_6: Look, I already found a suspicious <fish hook> right here!
strings.tr_qeuest_6_beekeeper_cs_7: He's definitely not himself. But this hook points towards the <Lighthouse Keeper>...
strings.tr_quest_10_beekeeper_1: Hey! Come here, I have an offer for you!
strings.tr_quest_10_beekeeper_3: You help me get one thing, and I'll help you to get the <Logger's belt>!
strings.tr_quest_10_beekeeper_4: By the way, if you refuse, then I'll be offended and order my bees to devour you.
strings.tr_quest_10_beekeeper_5: What a pushy fellow! So what is it you want?
strings.tr_quest_10_beekeeper_6: I buried a <barrel of honey> somewhere.
strings.tr_quest_10_beekeeper_7: But I can't go looking for it myself — my <enemies> will try to stab me!
strings.tr_quest_10_honey_found_2: But how can I be sure you haven't poisoned my <honey>?
strings.tr_quest_10_honey_found_3: What reason could I possibly have?
strings.tr_quest_10_honey_found_4: This village is full of my <enemies>, all of them more than happy to get rid of me!
strings.tr_quest_10_honey_found_5: Okay, I see. No, I didn't poison it. So...
strings.tr_quest_10_honey_found_6: Take this <honey plaster>. It's for the <Logger's back>. He's my one and only friend...
strings.tr_quest_10_logger_buckle_2: Nice to see you, friend. Want some fresh leaves to chew? It's invigorating!
strings.tr_quest_10_logger_buckle_3: Maybe next time. Tell me, do you really need that <belt and buckle> you're wearing?
strings.tr_quest_10_logger_buckle_4: Hmm... It does help with my <painful back>...
strings.tr_quest_10_logger_buckle_5: I'll pay you for it, so you can buy <another belt> for your back.
strings.tr_quest_10_logger_buckle_6: Oh... but I've got to really like this one...
strings.tr_quest_10_logger_buckle_7: And I've got used to picking my teeth with the buckle... hmm... Nope, this one is mine.
strings.tr_quest_10_logger_plaster_2: Hey look, this <plaster> will help you with your back!
strings.tr_quest_10_logger_plaster_3: Hm, all right, let's try it... O-o-o-h, that's just bliss! Here, the <belt> is yours.
strings.tr_quest_10_logger_plaster_4: <Beekeeper> said that you're his friend. What do you know about him?
strings.tr_quest_10_logger_plaster_5: He was stung by a bee when he was a child.
strings.tr_quest_10_logger_plaster_6: Ever since, he's considered himself a <Bee-man>.
strings.tr_quest_10_logger_plaster_7: He believes that bees are supreme beings. He wrote a bee bible and trains a bee army.
strings.tr_quest_10_logger_plaster_8: And he's certain that one of the villagers is his nemesis — <Hornetman>!
strings.tr_quest_11_adam_after_ghost_1_1: Adam, it was just a <ghost with a bipolar disorder>. Now you can sleep in peace.
strings.tr_quest_11_adam_after_ghost_4: Listen, could you... get him back? I'll feel lonely without him.
strings.tr_quest_11_adam_after_ghost_5: He's the only person who's really interested in me. He's almost my friend!
strings.tr_quest_11_adam_after_ghost_7: Here they are. Meh, there's no kindness left in this world!
strings.tr_quest_11_adam_postsherds_2: One more day, one more disappointment. What's new?
strings.tr_quest_11_adam_postsherds_3: Adam, I am in need of a certain trifling thing.
strings.tr_quest_11_adam_postsherds_4: <Clay shards of an ancient vase>. You could just give them to me for free, couldn't you?
strings.tr_quest_11_adam_postsherds_5: The priceless shards of the precious vase — for free?! Certainly not!
strings.tr_quest_11_adam_postsherds_6: I can tell you're making fun of me!
strings.tr_quest_11_adam_postsherds_7: Firstly, you must improve your <tavern>, to allow guests to enjoy these <shards> as exhibits!
strings.tr_quest_11_adam_postsherds_8: After that, I'll need <one thing more>.
strings.tr_quest_11_tavern_40_done_3: Now help me to get rid of the two <hooligans> who torture me at night.
strings.tr_quest_11_tavern_40_done_4: They stand near the <window> and whisper nasty things about me!
strings.tr_quest_11_tavern_40_done_5: And the strangest thing about it — I can never find any footprints!
strings.tr_quest_11_tavern_40_done_6: It's really strange. Just watch the place <at night>.
strings.tr_quest_11_yorick_1: Adam, chin up now, you're such a gifted potter!
strings.tr_quest_11_yorick_10: No worries, Keeper. It's just a fun game!
strings.tr_quest_11_yorick_11: <Adam> doesn't look like he's having fun.
strings.tr_quest_11_yorick_12: Besides, if my workers behave in this way, that would spoil my tavern's prestige. Should I fire you?
strings.tr_quest_11_yorick_13: Okay, okay. We were just trying to increase our self-esteem by humiliating <Adam>!
strings.tr_quest_11_yorick_14: But if you want us to stop — no problem. We'll move on to <another loser>. Bye!
strings.tr_quest_11_yorick_2: In your dreams. In real life, you're a hopeless failure.
strings.tr_quest_11_yorick_3: Look, Adam — your collection of antiques is amazing!
strings.tr_quest_11_yorick_4: Someone's probably going to steal it any day now!
strings.tr_quest_11_yorick_5: Things will work out, Adam. One day you'll be known throughout the land!
strings.tr_quest_11_yorick_6: Of course! The famous fool and whiner.
strings.tr_quest_11_yorick_8: Yorick, what a surprise! What are you doing?
strings.tr_quest_11_yorick_9: Oh no! We're discovered! Oh, how shameful.
strings.tr_quest_12_after_first_rat_race_2: Snake, a <rat race> has been organized. What do you say?
strings.tr_quest_12_after_first_rat_race_3: I know. My cultists have already gambled away all their money. Chumps!
strings.tr_quest_12_after_first_rat_race_4: Here's your amulet as we agreed.
strings.tr_quest_12_after_first_rat_race_6: The Lighthouse Keeper's race rats bit me while I was robbing him! Ow it hurts!
strings.tr_quest_12_after_first_rat_race_7: Maybe I can help you? You really need an injection!
strings.tr_quest_12_after_first_rat_race_8: An injection? Do you mean to put me down like a dog?!
strings.tr_quest_12_after_first_rat_race_9: Take the damned <amulet> and walk away while you still can!
strings.tr_quest_12_after_items_1: I brought everything you asked for. I hope you still haven't eaten that <apple>?
strings.tr_quest_12_after_items_2: No. Like father always said: never eat anything that's more profitable to sell.
strings.tr_quest_12_after_items_3: And he got extremely rich, you know. Though he died of exhaustion.
strings.tr_quest_12_after_items_4: After that, I gave away all my wealth to the poor, and moved here.
strings.tr_quest_12_lighthouse_am_10: Damn. I'll have to ask Snake to steal it.
strings.tr_quest_12_lighthouse_am_2: Listen, did you happen to seen a loud and obese woman in the Tavern asking about me?
strings.tr_quest_12_lighthouse_am_4: It's my former wife. An awful woman! She accuses me of robbing her!
strings.tr_quest_12_lighthouse_am_5: But it was only fair compensation for a great many spoiled years of my life!
strings.tr_quest_12_lighthouse_am_6: A bit of linen, some dishes, a picture, this amulet... all our savings...
strings.tr_quest_12_lighthouse_am_7: Is it the <Amulet of the Ancient God>? Would you sell it to me?
strings.tr_quest_12_lighthouse_am_8: I'm sorry but I can't. It's simply too important for me.
strings.tr_quest_12_lighthouse_am_9: It reminds me of that happy day I won freedom!
strings.tr_quest_12_logger_tavern_1: Hey, friend. Do you want this <apple>?
strings.tr_quest_12_logger_tavern_2: Wow, it's a golden apple! Of course I want it. Where did you find it?
strings.tr_quest_12_logger_tavern_3: I've found a young apple tree this morning, deep in the forest. On it hung this <apple>.
strings.tr_quest_12_logger_tavern_4: As usual, I cut the tree down, chopped it up for wood. Then I decided to have a snack...
strings.tr_quest_12_logger_tavern_5: And I broke two teeth on this damn <apple>!
strings.tr_quest_12_logger_tavern_6: If you really want it, bring me <roof tile> and <curtains> for my home.
strings.tr_quest_12_logger_tavern_7: Like father always said: the most important thing about a home is a solid roof and — and no prying neighbors!
strings.tr_quest_12_snake_asking_2: Snake, first of all — thanks for everything you've done for me!
strings.tr_quest_12_snake_asking_3: Don't try to flatter me. You sound pathetic. What do you want?
strings.tr_quest_12_snake_asking_4: I need you to steal an <amulet> from the Lighthouse Keeper. Are you up for it?
strings.tr_quest_12_snake_asking_5a: I'm not sure. That guy stinks of raw fish, and I'm allergic to fish scales.
strings.tr_quest_12_snake_asking_5b: It's not a good time. I just ate a big meal, so my reflexes are slow, you know...
strings.tr_quest_12_snake_asking_5b_1: Although... I'll do it if you help me.
strings.tr_quest_12_snake_asking_5b_3: It's been over a month since my cultists have caught an inquisitor and drowned him in the river.
strings.tr_quest_12_snake_asking_5b_4: I guess they need proper motivation.
strings.tr_quest_12_snake_asking_5b_5: Organize <rat races> in your tavern for them!
strings.tr_quest_12_snake_asking_after_refuse: Snake, I still need you to steal an <amulet> from the Lighthouse Keeper. Maybe...
strings.tr_quest_13_after_research: Oh yes! Your <research work> was the best they've seen in a decade! I'm restored!
strings.tr_quest_13_research_2: Maybe, this <research about obsidian> will be a suitable substitute for the <book> you requested?
strings.tr_quest_13_research_3: Let me look at it. Hmm. It looks serious enough...
strings.tr_quest_13_research_4: Have you heard about this rare mineral?
strings.tr_quest_13_research_5: Certainly. But you're the first who has written so many pages about the stone!
strings.tr_quest_13_research_6: My, my... I definitely like it! I'll have to present it to my colleagues at the university as <my work>. There's much to do!
strings.tr_quest_13_research_7: In any case, I'll have the result for you in a week.
strings.tr_quest_13_research_8: By the way, if you'd like to write anything else, I'll be glad to buy it.
strings.tr_quest_14_after_scroll_1: Hm! Something went wrong, your <hump> is still there like usual.
strings.tr_quest_14_after_scroll_10: I'm much more tolerant towards hunchbacks!
strings.tr_quest_14_after_scroll_11: That's good. But I'm not tolerant of <bad taverns>.
strings.tr_quest_14_after_scroll_12: But you put out some decent tables and chairs, and you'll get the <pickaxe>.
strings.tr_quest_14_after_scroll_2: Er... But look! Now you have a <hump>! Ha, and look over there, a pair of <hunchback squirrels>!
strings.tr_quest_14_after_scroll_3: Really? No, I don't see anything like that.
strings.tr_quest_14_after_scroll_4: Oh! I know! This spell makes you <see everyone like you> — with humps!
strings.tr_quest_14_after_scroll_5: It's an illusion? Meh! I thought now everyone had humps. That would have been cool!
strings.tr_quest_14_after_scroll_6: So... I see you've failed. You can forget about the <pickaxe>!
strings.tr_quest_14_after_scroll_8: Listen, Koukol! How about free drinks at my <tavern>?
strings.tr_quest_14_after_scroll_9: Well... Horadric doesn't even let me into his inn, because I tend to scare off the customers.
strings.tr_quest_14_after_tavern_improve_2: Free service awaits you. Is that enough?
strings.tr_quest_14_after_tavern_improve_3: Maybe. Maybe... Okay, okay, don't turn white. Take your <pickaxe>.
strings.tr_quest_14_help_koukol_10: They are marked with the <Ancient Curse>.
strings.tr_quest_14_help_koukol_11: You might befriend and ask <Inquisitor>, if you want to know the details.
strings.tr_quest_14_help_koukol_2: How are you, my sweet? What can an old lady do for you?
strings.tr_quest_14_help_koukol_3: Clotho, can you rid a man of a <hump>?
strings.tr_quest_14_help_koukol_4: Oh, I'm so sorry, my sweet! And you're so young! Here, let Clotho take a look...
strings.tr_quest_14_help_koukol_6: Not you? Thank the Ancient God. Such a beautiful Keeper with a hump! Yuck!
strings.tr_quest_14_help_koukol_7: Believe me, it's not me! My... hm... friend Koukol wants to <look like everyone else>. He...
strings.tr_quest_14_help_koukol_8: Oh, I see. Take this <spell scroll>. You'll also need a <dark organ>, and Koukol definitely has a couple.
strings.tr_quest_14_koukol_2: What do you need? You're spoiling my business.
strings.tr_quest_14_koukol_3: It looks to me like I'm your only customer at the moment.
strings.tr_quest_14_koukol_4: Then buy something and get out!
strings.tr_quest_14_koukol_6: Really? Hm. That's a rare pickaxe, I heard it once belonged to the <First King>!
strings.tr_quest_14_koukol_7: You really want it? Then help me with my <hump>!
strings.tr_quest_14_koukol_8: The doctors are useless. Find a <witch> who can help. I want to look like everyone else!
strings.tr_quest_14_koukol_next_w_2: Take this one! A few days ago we cut down a crowd of <walking dead> near the <Pass>.
strings.tr_quest_14_koukol_next_w_3: What are you waiting for? Read the <spell>!
strings.tr_quest_14_koukol_next_w_4: Are you sure? Maybe we should talk about <safety> precautions?
strings.tr_quest_14_koukol_next_w_5: Read it. Or I'll kill you!!
strings.tr_quest_14_koukol_next_w_6: Boom-boom, bum-bum, want to look like everyone!
strings.tr_quest_14_koukol_next_w_7: Boom-boom, bum-bum, want to look like everyone!
strings.tr_quest_14_koukol_next_w_8: Boom-boom, bum-bum, want to look like everyone!
strings.tr_quest_14_scroll_show_2: What took you so long?! Even with my limp I could have done it faster!
strings.tr_quest_14_scroll_show_3: If you want to get rid of your <hump>, please, keep quiet and listen.
strings.tr_quest_14_scroll_show_4: I have a magic <scroll>. But we'll also need a <dark organ>.
strings.tr_quest_14_scroll_show_5: A <dark organ>? That's easy! Take your pick: a heart, brain, or intestine?
strings.tr_quest_15_about_ancient_keys_2: It won't be easy to convince <Adam> to let me inside his <home>...
strings.tr_quest_15_about_ancient_keys_3: Adam, I've been waiting a long time for the chance to see your collection of antiques!
strings.tr_quest_15_about_ancient_keys_4: You really want to see them? Why? You plan to criticize me? Or you gonna break something?
strings.tr_quest_15_about_ancient_keys_5: Nope, I just wanted to enjoy the art!
strings.tr_quest_15_about_ancient_keys_6: Hm... You don't look like an art connoisseur to me.
strings.tr_quest_15_about_ancient_keys_7: Prove it. Bring me <three high-quality vases>.
strings.tr_quest_15_adam_vases_10: I can always talk to <Merchant> about the <vases> I need.
strings.tr_quest_15_adam_vases_2: Adam, look at these <vases>! They're masterpieces!
strings.tr_quest_15_adam_vases_3: Hmph! Vases? Those aren't vases, they're crooked glass pots!
strings.tr_quest_15_adam_vases_4: You think I'm a fool and a drunkard, and you can slip me this garbage?! Never!
strings.tr_quest_15_adam_vases_5: Okay, don't get upset! What kind of <vases> do you want?
strings.tr_quest_15_adam_vases_7: About your vases... I'm only buying them so I can break them. Take (slv)5.
strings.tr_quest_15_adam_vases_9: Just (slv)5?! I think I'd better keep them for myself.
strings.tr_quest_15_beekeeper_vase_11: Put <poisoned honey> into the <vases>. <Adam> will taste it and die.
strings.tr_quest_15_beekeeper_vase_12: Excellent plan! I'll get my revenge at last! But...
strings.tr_quest_15_beekeeper_vase_13: Alas, my <hyper-toxic bee poison> were stolen by my other foe, <Dig>.
strings.tr_quest_15_beekeeper_vase_14: Time to go talk to Dig...
strings.tr_quest_15_beekeeper_vase_2: Aha! I know you've been talking to <Adam>! He sent you to kill me — and my bees!
strings.tr_quest_15_beekeeper_vase_3: Believe it or not, I just need the <vases> you bought.
strings.tr_quest_15_beekeeper_vase_4: You want to give them to <Adam>?
strings.tr_quest_15_beekeeper_vase_6: Aha! That's why I bought them! I knew <Adam> wanted them!
strings.tr_quest_15_beekeeper_vase_7: I figured out that Adam is <Hornetman>! And I've foiled my enemy's plans!
strings.tr_quest_15_beekeeper_vase_8: He's crazy, but I need those <vases>. Hmph!
strings.tr_quest_15_beekeeper_vase_9: You're right. He is <Hornetman>. And this is your chance to defeat him!
strings.tr_quest_15_dig_cutscene_1: Welcome! Welcome! Guests, taste this divine <cake> I made!
strings.tr_quest_15_dig_cutscene_10: <It grows in spring, it falls in fall>.
strings.tr_quest_15_dig_cutscene_16: Yes! <Cakes with bee poison>! Hooray, you won a whole cake!
strings.tr_quest_15_dig_cutscene_17: Cool! I'll share some of it with <Beekeeper> and come back to play some more.
strings.tr_quest_15_dig_cutscene_18: Okay, but be careful with that guy! I think he's crazy!
strings.tr_quest_15_dig_cutscene_2: Hm, it looks delicious! What's it made of?
strings.tr_quest_15_dig_cutscene_4: The perfect way to keep people as your guests forever!
strings.tr_quest_15_dig_cutscene_5: Wow! Er... It's quite tempting, but...
strings.tr_quest_15_dig_cutscene_6: Take a bite — or I'll bite you. This is my holiday! I'm the host!
strings.tr_quest_15_dig_cutscene_7: I need a new plan. Right now!
strings.tr_quest_15_dig_cutscene_8: If it's your holiday, then let's play some <games> before we eat the cake.
strings.tr_quest_15_dig_cutscene_9: Some games? How nice! I'll be the Sphynx, and you'll be the fool! Listen to my <riddle>:
strings.tr_quest_15_merchant_vase_2: My friend! Do you have any expensive <vases>?
strings.tr_quest_15_merchant_vase_3: Oh, unfortunately you're a bit too late. I just sold them.
strings.tr_quest_15_merchant_vase_5: To that weirdo. <Beekeeper>. I'm sure you've seen him around.
strings.tr_quest_15_poisoned_pie_3: Take all the <poison> from that cake, mix it with <honey>, and put it in the <vases>.
strings.tr_quest_15_poisoned_pie_4: Wait a minute. Oh, my revenge will be sweet, <Hornetman>!
strings.tr_quest_15_poisoned_pie_5: Ready! Take the <vases> and hurry to <Adam>!
strings.tr_quest_15_vases_again_2: There's honey inside. Don't ask why.
strings.tr_quest_15_vases_again_3: But I advise you to throw it away. It doesn't look fresh.
strings.tr_quest_15_vases_again_4: Yuck! <Honey> reminds me of that wonderful woman, the pastry chef, who rejected me!
strings.tr_quest_15_vases_again_6: In any case, the <vases> are quite nice. Welcome to my home.
strings.tr_quest_17_clotho_mother_10: We are immortal, but using magic saps our health.
strings.tr_quest_17_clotho_mother_11: Bella lost her health and died.
strings.tr_quest_17_clotho_mother_12: What about you? You also use <magic>.
strings.tr_quest_17_clotho_mother_13: I take a <cure>. It damages my memory, but it saves me.
strings.tr_quest_17_clotho_mother_14: That's a sad story. I've heard enough. It's time I return to the <Farmer>.
strings.tr_quest_17_clotho_mother_2: Clotho, did you know the <Farmer's wife>?
strings.tr_quest_17_clotho_mother_3: Hmm... Maybe you could pay me one little <compliment> first? I've been so lonely in this swamp...
strings.tr_quest_17_clotho_mother_5: Clotho, your chin is so... attractive. All three of them.
strings.tr_quest_17_clotho_mother_6: Oh my dear, you're so cute! All right, listen.
strings.tr_quest_17_clotho_mother_7: I knew the <Farmer's wife> better than any other. <Bella> was my sister, along with Chain.
strings.tr_quest_17_clotho_mother_8: They both left me here and moved to the <Village>. Both even got married.
strings.tr_quest_17_clotho_mother_9: <Bella> overused her magic in curing people, and in bearing a <son and daughter>.
strings.tr_quest_17_farmer_again_2: I already asked you to lay off. What more do you want?!
strings.tr_quest_17_farmer_again_3: I just want to say that I sympathize with you and your loss.
strings.tr_quest_17_farmer_again_4: <Your wife> was an amazing woman. Her death is a real tragedy.
strings.tr_quest_17_farmer_again_5: You know... The <inquisitors> once spoke of burning her as a witch.
strings.tr_quest_17_farmer_again_6: By then she was sick a lot. So I asked her to stop curing people.
strings.tr_quest_17_farmer_again_7: But she said — so many people can be saved in exchange for one life!
strings.tr_quest_17_farmer_again_8: He's crying. Better leave him alone for a bit.
strings.tr_quest_17_farmer_once_more_1: She used her magic to bear the <daughter> she always dreamed of. And it killed her.
strings.tr_quest_17_farmer_once_more_2: I know. Listen, I need your <wife's ring>. Could you sell it to me?
strings.tr_quest_17_farmer_once_more_4: One is in her <grave> in the field. The another is the only thing she left me.
strings.tr_quest_17_farmer_once_more_5: Okay, don't sell it. I have an idea.
strings.tr_quest_17_farmer_once_more_6: Take this (gld)1 for the ring, and spend it on your children.
strings.tr_quest_17_farmer_once_more_7: Bella always wanted <our son> to study at the University.
strings.tr_quest_17_farmer_once_more_8: I'll spend your gold on that. Thank you, my friend.
strings.tr_quest_17_farmers_wife_2: Hey, I don't like seeing your smelly beard here every day!
strings.tr_quest_17_farmers_wife_3: Just one question and I'll stop bothering you.
strings.tr_quest_17_farmers_wife_4: Ask faster, I'm missing my work.
strings.tr_quest_17_farmers_wife_6: None of your damn business. Lay off. And stay away from me!
strings.tr_quest_17_farmers_wife_8: Why did he grow so pale? Maybe <his son> will be more talkative...
strings.tr_quest_17_miller_mother_2: Hello. Want to compete with my <rats>? You're welcome to try!
strings.tr_quest_17_miller_mother_3: Could you tell me something about your <brother's wife>?
strings.tr_quest_17_miller_mother_4: Well... She was a <healer>. An amazing healer, and an amazing beauty!
strings.tr_quest_17_miller_mother_5: My <Brother> fell in love with her after she saved his life.
strings.tr_quest_17_miller_mother_6: Because of her incredible skills, people sometimes said she was a <witch>.
strings.tr_quest_17_miller_mother_7: Hm... You should ask <Clotho> in the swamp. She might know more.
strings.tr_quest_17_son_mother_2: It seems like father's mood today is even worse than usual.
strings.tr_quest_17_son_mother_3: I asked him about your <mother>, and he became strangely upset.
strings.tr_quest_17_son_mother_4: He loved Mom so much! She was so beautiful and kind.
strings.tr_quest_17_son_mother_5: But she was weak. She was often sick, and sometimes fainted.
strings.tr_quest_17_son_mother_6: It was heartwrenching when she died. <Father> has been grieving ever since.
strings.tr_quest_17_son_mother_7: I see. Hmm. His uncle the <Miller> must know more.
strings.tr_quest_18_baron_rat_11: That's too much for me, I'll come back later.
strings.tr_quest_18_baron_rat_2: Excuse me, could you lend me your <rat>? I need it for the race.
strings.tr_quest_18_baron_rat_3: My rat? Hm... But I didn't buy it as a race rat!
strings.tr_quest_18_baron_rat_4: Look at him. Have you ever seen such wise eyes, or such a clever face?
strings.tr_quest_18_baron_rat_5: This rat is the <Chosen One>! He'll be the keeper of all the gypsy people's knowledge!
strings.tr_quest_18_baron_rat_6: One day I will die, and it is my duty to share with this rat all that I know!
strings.tr_quest_18_baron_rat_7: Okay, I hear you. So how much gold do you want?
strings.tr_quest_18_baron_rat_8: Well now you're talking! (gld)1 and this <rat> is yours.
strings.tr_quest_18_dig_accept_rat_10: Yes, sometimes it's so funny to pretend to be a psycho.
strings.tr_quest_18_dig_accept_rat_12: It's a strange world... The only way a wise man can survive is by pretending to be a psycho...
strings.tr_quest_18_dig_accept_rat_2: Wow, cool rat! Hooray, here comes my debut!
strings.tr_quest_18_dig_accept_rat_3: Thank you, my boy! I'll... I'll double your take for the next race! Yeah!
strings.tr_quest_18_dig_accept_rat_4: Excellent. But I also need your <signet>.
strings.tr_quest_18_dig_accept_rat_6: Your signet, the signet you like to lick!
strings.tr_quest_18_dig_accept_rat_7: Lick a signet? Yuck! Who thought of that?
strings.tr_quest_18_dig_accept_rat_8: Oh dear... Just give it to me!
strings.tr_quest_18_dig_accept_rat_9: Take it, of course. I was just going to throw it away in any case. Ha ha!
strings.tr_quest_18_dig_rat_2: Ah, you there with the hump! Look here, look at my collection!
strings.tr_quest_18_dig_rat_3: It's inspiring to see just <hunchbacks> walking about!
strings.tr_quest_18_dig_rat_5: Oh, I see. But all my <rats> have been sold. It's all thanks to my business partner, <Piper>!
strings.tr_quest_18_dig_rat_6: He gathered everyone else's <rats> in the area, and sold them to the town zoo!
strings.tr_quest_18_dig_rat_7: All the <rat trainers> lined up to give me their money for my rats!
strings.tr_quest_18_dig_rat_8: And my best rat was sold to... hm... the <Gypsy Baron>!
strings.tr_quest_18_keeper_rat_2: Again? Whatever you suspect me of, I'm not guilty!
strings.tr_quest_18_keeper_rat_3: In fact, today I'm the victim!
strings.tr_quest_18_keeper_rat_5: Some boy from the <Town> was walking past the lighthouse, playing his <pipe>.
strings.tr_quest_18_keeper_rat_6: And as he left, all my trained <rats> went away with him!
strings.tr_quest_18_keeper_rat_7: Damned! I really wanted to borrow a <rat>!
strings.tr_quest_18_keeper_rat_8: <Koukol> sells rats. But don't tell anybody I told you.
strings.tr_quest_18_priests_signet_2: Did you already eat my <bee-poison cake>? Was it tasty?
strings.tr_quest_18_priests_signet_3: Of course. I've nearly died of pleasure.
strings.tr_quest_18_priests_signet_4: Dig, you have a certain trivial thing — the <priest's signet>. It's certainly not very tasty.
strings.tr_quest_18_priests_signet_5: Do you mind if I take it?
strings.tr_quest_18_priests_signet_6: Er... Actually it is pretty sweet. Every morning I dip it in honey and lick it...
strings.tr_quest_18_priests_signet_7: Listen! The whole village is going crazy over your <rat races>. And I want to get in on it too!
strings.tr_quest_18_priests_signet_8: The <Lighthouse Keeper> has the best racing rats. Bring me one.
strings.tr_quest_18_priests_signet_9: And I'll find something else to lick.
strings.tr_quest_4_carrot_done_2: There! Have you ever seen such a <carrot>?
strings.tr_quest_4_carrot_done_3: You call that a <big carrot>? Ha! I used to raise mine much bigger. When I was younger.
strings.tr_quest_4_clotho_carrot_11: Okay, I'll try to organize your <date>. Umm...
strings.tr_quest_4_clotho_carrot_3: Hah... Every week... Sure, I can increase <"your thing">.
strings.tr_quest_4_clotho_carrot_4: No, no, you misunderstand. I need you to enlarge my <carrot>.
strings.tr_quest_4_clotho_carrot_5: That's a funny way to put it.
strings.tr_quest_4_clotho_carrot_6: No, I need you to make an actual <carrot> the size of a <log>!
strings.tr_quest_4_clotho_carrot_7: Oh. That's even easier! But in return, I want a <date>.
strings.tr_quest_4_clotho_carrot_8: A <date>? Ehm...  Listen, I'm full of flaws! Moreover...
strings.tr_quest_4_clotho_carrot_9: Not you, my sweet, though you are pretty cute.
strings.tr_quest_4_cory_clot_date_2: Cory, want to go on a <date> with an amazing beauty?
strings.tr_quest_4_cory_clot_date_3: I'd love to! Don't judge me by my age, I'm still strong and hot!
strings.tr_quest_4_cory_clot_date_4: There's a catch: she... she was a beauty. A very long time ago. It's <Clotho>.
strings.tr_quest_4_cory_clot_date_5: Wow! Sorry, but <crazy old ladies> are a bit beyond my taste.
strings.tr_quest_4_cory_clot_date_6: Well, that's too bad, but I can't blame him.
strings.tr_quest_4_cory_clot_date_7: Maybe, his brother <Tress> would know how to make Cory agree...
strings.tr_quest_4_deny_date_2: Cory was delighted by my invitation, wasn't he?
strings.tr_quest_4_deny_date_3: Yeah, but I wouldn't recommend going on that date with <Cory>.
strings.tr_quest_4_deny_date_4: Once I got near him, I noticed <cursed runes> on his red clothes!
strings.tr_quest_4_deny_date_5: His eyes <flamed>, and his breath resembled <roaring>! It was terrifying!
strings.tr_quest_4_deny_date_6: A <foul spirit>! I should have guessed! And it was thanks to you that I avoided a terrible fate!
strings.tr_quest_4_deny_date_8: Thank you, thank you so much! Now let me enlarge your <carrot>.
strings.tr_quest_4_farmer_visit_2: This may sound strange, but could I look at something inside <your home>?
strings.tr_quest_4_farmer_visit_3: Inside my home? Are you crazy?
strings.tr_quest_4_farmer_visit_4: I bet you're just trying to steal something!
strings.tr_quest_4_farmer_visit_5: No, no, no, I just wanted to talk farming! Please!
strings.tr_quest_4_farmer_visit_6: I only talk farming to professionals!
strings.tr_quest_4_farmer_visit_7: Grow a <carrot> the size of a... <log>. Then I'll let you in.
strings.tr_quest_4_farmer_visit_8: The size as a log? Yikes. I'll need some <magical help>.
strings.tr_quest_4_lucrative_deal_2: Cory, what do you think about a <lucrative deal>?
strings.tr_quest_4_lucrative_deal_3: I don't think about them, I make them. You have an idea?
strings.tr_quest_4_lucrative_deal_4: Yes. A monopoly on the sales of high-class magic potions. At first...
strings.tr_quest_4_lucrative_deal_5: Fantastic! Say no more, and name the <supplier>!
strings.tr_quest_4_lucrative_deal_7: I urgently need to have a meeting with her! Go and arrange it!
strings.tr_quest_4_success_date_2: Cory was delighted by my invitation, wasn't he?
strings.tr_quest_4_success_date_3: Yeah, he was very excited! He wants to know the place and time.
strings.tr_quest_4_success_date_4: Oh, wonderful! Where's your <carrot>? I'll make it the size of a windmill!
strings.tr_quest_4_success_date_5: Thanks, but the size of a <log> is enough.
strings.tr_quest_4_tress_advice_2: Good to see you! Is it something important?
strings.tr_quest_4_tress_advice_3: Tress, how can I get <Cory> to do something he doesn't want?
strings.tr_quest_4_tress_advice_4: You know what Cory taught me? That good advice costs good money. (slv)10.
strings.tr_quest_4_tress_advice_5a: That's a highway robbery, but I agree.
strings.tr_quest_4_tress_advice_5a_1: Good! Cory is crazy about <lucrative deals>. You can use that to your advantage.
strings.tr_quest_6_after_1st_stup_1: It was epic, man! Look, they're waiting for my autograph!
strings.tr_quest_6_after_1st_stup_2: Here, take Miller's <invitation>. Ha ha, your Shows are much better than the ones in the Town!
strings.tr_quest_6_anc_lock_10: Search <the territory around my home and the mill> for starters.
strings.tr_quest_6_anc_lock_2: Whatever you want — save it for next time. Today I'm in a fury!
strings.tr_quest_6_anc_lock_3: Okay, I'll just need to borrow the <lockpicks> you're holding.
strings.tr_quest_6_anc_lock_4: No way. It's the only <clue>! Imagine, some crook has stolen the <invitation>!
strings.tr_quest_6_anc_lock_5: It was an invitation to participate in the official <Comedy Show> in the Town!
strings.tr_quest_6_anc_lock_6: I passed five qualifying rounds for the competition! I paid six bribes!
strings.tr_quest_6_anc_lock_7: And when did you discover that the <invitation> was stolen?
strings.tr_quest_6_anc_lock_8: Well, I'd just returned home from the <tavern>, and saw these <lockpicks> in my keyhole. And you know the rest.
strings.tr_quest_6_anc_lock_9: Listen! Get me my <invitation> back, and the <lockpicks> are yours!
strings.tr_quest_6_item_1_payer_1: <Pie>? Someone must have had a picnic here. A long time ago, judging by the <mold>.
strings.tr_quest_6_item_2_player_1: A <rope and noose>. Hmm... Oh, there's a <note>!
strings.tr_quest_6_item_2_player_3: It looks like Adam couldn't find a <suitable branch>. Poor man!
strings.tr_quest_6_item_3_payer_1: I knew this would be a good day!
strings.tr_quest_6_light_kpr_cs_1: Where's my favorite <fishing hook>? Where are you, my boy?
strings.tr_quest_6_light_kpr_cs_10: But there has to be a drum set. Otherwise, my jokes don't work.
strings.tr_quest_6_light_kpr_cs_2: Well... Luckily, I have plenty of other favorite hooks.
strings.tr_quest_6_light_kpr_cs_5: Never. He's a fraud! Those are my jokes he's telling at the Comedy Show!
strings.tr_quest_6_light_kpr_cs_6: They should invite me, not him!
strings.tr_quest_6_light_kpr_cs_7: Thanks to him, I've lost my chance to become a famous comic!
strings.tr_quest_6_light_kpr_cs_8: Hm... You know what? I could organize a <Comedy Show> in my tavern, and you could perform there.
strings.tr_quest_6_light_kpr_cs_9: Really? You'd do that for me? Oh, my savior! Let me kiss you!
strings.tr_quest_6_miller_inv_3: Yeah, here's your <invitation>. And good luck in the Town competition!
strings.tr_quest_6_miller_inv_4: Hm... You know what? I changed my mind.
strings.tr_quest_6_miller_inv_5: The Town's competitions are always so boring. The prizes go to the highest bidder...
strings.tr_quest_6_miller_inv_6: So I don't need this <invitation> more.
strings.tr_quest_6_miller_inv_8: Allow me to take part in your local Comedy Shows! They're great! And the <lockpicks> are yours!
strings.tr_quest_7_about_booze_again_2: Is it still too hard for you to get the <booze>?
strings.tr_quest_7_about_booze_again_3: Hmm... Actually, that guy owes me and it'll be a pleasure to shake him down.
strings.tr_quest_7_about_booze_again_4: Okay. Your <booze> will be here in a week.
strings.tr_quest_7_booze_2: If you still need <booze>, I'm ready to trade some for the <medallion>.
strings.tr_quest_7_booze_3: Is it pure? I better check. Ignite it.
strings.tr_quest_7_booze_6: Whee! What a fireball! That was a really pure product!
strings.tr_quest_7_booze_7: Here's this <medallion>. Take care! — And remember: all we need is...
strings.tr_quest_7_booze_8: May your cakes last forever, Dig.
strings.tr_quest_7_booze_after_week_2: That's some high-class alcohol! It's a pity to waste it on you, but a deal's a deal.
strings.tr_quest_7_cake_1_2: Cakes are all we need! Yeah! All we need is cakes! Sing it with me: cakes are...
strings.tr_quest_7_cake_3: Hmm, I hid it away from time. Time, that spoils all and makes everything older...
strings.tr_quest_7_cake_4: Dig, I can offer you good money for that <medallion>.
strings.tr_quest_7_cake_5: Money isn't tasty. Cakes are tasty! But time... Time spoils them too...
strings.tr_quest_7_cake_6: Hey! I need <booze>! I'll submerge my cakes in it, and that will keep them forever!
strings.tr_quest_7_cake_7: Who can find me some booze? <Snake>?
strings.tr_quest_7_cake_8: Or I could try to make it myself.
strings.tr_quest_7_krezvold_sword_1: Psst! You! You're exactly who I needed to see!
strings.tr_quest_7_krezvold_sword_3: Take this <Damask sword>. You'll have to get rid of it or destroy it!
strings.tr_quest_7_krezvold_sword_4: Er... But why? It's very rare!
strings.tr_quest_7_krezvold_sword_5: A client asked me to melt it down, but I couldn't.
strings.tr_quest_7_krezvold_sword_6: Today I heard that someone in the <Town> was killed with a sword like this!
strings.tr_quest_7_krezvold_sword_7: Anyway, it's your sword now, and your problem too. See you!
strings.tr_quest_7_snake_booze_2: Do you know where I can find <booze> in these parts?
strings.tr_quest_7_snake_booze_3: I don't know. But I know someone who does.
strings.tr_quest_7_snake_booze_4: So can you arrange it for me?
strings.tr_quest_7_snake_booze_4a: Oh yes. But it's hard to get together with this guy, and I'm totally busy.
strings.tr_quest_7_snake_booze_4a_1: In other words, maybe next time. Or later. Or never.
strings.tr_quest_7_snake_booze_4b: Hmm. That guy owes me. It'll be a pleasure to shake him down.
strings.tr_quest_7_snake_booze_4b_1: Your <booze> will be here in a week.
strings.tr_quest_8_cory_dagger_2: Cory, have you ever considered becoming a <gypsy baron>?
strings.tr_quest_8_cory_dagger_3: Mmm, you must have heard about that <dagger>! You tried to pull it out too?
strings.tr_quest_8_cory_dagger_4: No, I was too late. Did you do it?
strings.tr_quest_8_cory_dagger_5: I tried half the night. I was planning on selling it to one of the gypsies. But I failed.
strings.tr_quest_8_gypsy_look4dagger_1: Hmnh... Strange. It was right here. I stuck it in that <stump>!
strings.tr_quest_8_gypsy_look4dagger_2: Er... What are you on about?
strings.tr_quest_8_gypsy_look4dagger_3: The thing is, I decided to choose a <successor>. According to the old ways.
strings.tr_quest_8_gypsy_look4dagger_4: Only the most deserving gypsy can pull the <dagger> from the <charmed stump>!
strings.tr_quest_8_gypsy_look4dagger_5: Yesterday I found a <dagger> right here, stuck it in that <stump>, and read the spell.
strings.tr_quest_8_gypsy_look4dagger_6: And now it's gone? Hmm. Was anyone here with you yesterday?
strings.tr_quest_8_gypsy_look4dagger_7: Four gypsies... And the <Logger>... and that engineer... um... <Cory>!
strings.tr_quest_8_krez_after_charm_2: I guessed as much. <Horadric> is terribly upset — and it's a nice change.
strings.tr_quest_8_krez_after_charm_3: So here's my <dagger>. By the way, I had <one other dagger>, but I lost it.
strings.tr_quest_8_krez_after_charm_4: It's really expensive. So you can look for it in the <forest>.
strings.tr_quest_8_krezvold_dgr_2: I never much liked the annoyances of Graveyard Keepers!
strings.tr_quest_8_krezvold_dgr_3: I'll try to be brief. May I borrow your <ancient dagger>?
strings.tr_quest_8_krezvold_dgr_4: Pff. I'd be happy to give it to you forever. But first you have to help me.
strings.tr_quest_8_krezvold_dgr_5: <Horadric's mood> has been too pleasant these last few days. Let's spoil it.
strings.tr_quest_8_krezvold_dgr_6: Many people visit Horadric's tavern just to listen to <Ms. Charm's songs>...
strings.tr_quest_8_krezvold_dgr_7: Persuade her to sing in your tavern too, and Horadric will turn green in anger!
strings.tr_quest_8_logger_dagger_3: Great! I'm so much happier here than I was in our big boring luxurious mansion!
strings.tr_quest_8_logger_dagger_4: Fifty push-ups and a bark sandwich — and you're the king of the world!
strings.tr_quest_8_logger_dagger_5: Fifty push-ups? Hmm. So you could easily have pulled that <dagger> out, couldn't you?
strings.tr_quest_8_logger_dagger_6: Ha! I wasted a whole hour beside that <stump> with nothing to show for it! Alas...
strings.tr_quest_8_singing_charm_2: I'm sorry, my dear, but I can't waste my time chatting.
strings.tr_quest_8_singing_charm_3: Please understand, my income depends on the number of songs I sing.
strings.tr_quest_8_singing_charm_4: That's what I wanted to talk to you about! Could I hire you to sing in <my tavern>?
strings.tr_quest_8_singing_charm_5: Well... I suppose I could find some free evenings for you. It will cost (slv)20 for the first show.
strings.tr_quest_8_singing_charm_6: And if everything goes well, I'll agree to perform for free next times.
strings.tr_quest_8_singing_charm_7a: It's expensive as hell, but I agree.
strings.tr_quest_8_singing_charm_7a_1: My dear, my voice is more valuable than you can imagine!
strings.tr_quest_8_singing_charm_7b_1: Of course not! But... well, it's better than nothing.
strings.tr_quest_8_singing_charm_7c: I don't have enough money. I'll come back later.
strings.tr_quest_8_tress_dagger_2: Tress, did you happen to come across an <ancient weapon> in the <forest>?
strings.tr_quest_8_tress_dagger_3: Nope. Sorry, I'm busy washing mushrooms.
strings.tr_quest_8_tress_dagger_4: Wait! But what are you cutting the mushrooms with?
strings.tr_quest_8_tress_dagger_5: I use a knife. But...  uhh... this morning I lost it.
strings.tr_quest_8_tress_dagger_6: But fortunately, I found some old <dagger> stuck in a <stump>.
strings.tr_quest_8_tress_dagger_7: Here, you can take this old piece of junk if you want it.
strings.tr_quest_8_tress_dagger_8: That's funny, I just spoke to future <gypsy baron>!
strings.tr_quest_about_trip_2: Horadric, I heard about your last trip to the <Town>... You got any details?
strings.tr_quest_about_trip_4: It looks like my last hope is <Krezvold>.
strings.tr_quest_ch_cs_1: Listen, <Horadric> earns tons of money, but he doesn't spend it on me.
strings.tr_quest_ch_cs_2: He spends it all on booze and girls!
strings.tr_quest_ch_cs_4: He went to the <Town> with <Krezvold> last week.
strings.tr_quest_ch_cs_5: And when he got back, I smelled a woman's <perfume> on his clothes!
strings.tr_quest_ch_cs_6: Anyway, I need you to find some <evidence>. Then you'll get the <statuette>.
strings.tr_quest_ch_stat_2: Hi. Horadric sent me to ask you where his <statuette> is.
strings.tr_quest_ch_stat_3: Ah! And why do I have to keep track of his stuff?!
strings.tr_quest_ch_stat_5: No way. We haven't talked for a week.
strings.tr_quest_fl_dont_snitch_1: Do you have a moment, friend?
strings.tr_quest_fl_dont_snitch_2: I must thank you. It's thanks to you that I can be proud of <my son>!
strings.tr_quest_fl_dont_snitch_3: I've waited for such a long time, until the day he started drinking in secret!
strings.tr_quest_fl_dont_snitch_5: Yes! The twerp finally found the gumption to disobey me!
strings.tr_quest_fl_dont_snitch_6: My boy is growing up! It's a good thing you never told me anything about that <flask>!
strings.tr_quest_fl_snitch_2: My friend, it is my duty to inform you that <your son> drinks <wine>!
strings.tr_quest_fl_snitch_6: Besides, it's <my flask> and I didn't say you could have it. That'll be (slv)5, please.
strings.tr_quest_hor_stat_2: Hi. Lend me your <Statuette of the Ancient God>, please.
strings.tr_quest_hor_stat_3: Hm. Who told you about that?
strings.tr_quest_hor_stat_4: Do you believe in talking skulls?
strings.tr_quest_hor_stat_5: I even believe in talking donkeys.
strings.tr_quest_hor_stat_6: That <statuette> was forcing me to be sad. I'll be glad to get rid of it.
strings.tr_quest_hor_stat_7: Ask my wife <Chain> where it is. She does the cleaning.
strings.tr_quest_horadrics_secret_2: Krezvold said that Horadric bought a new <perfume> for you. It's a <secret>!
strings.tr_quest_horadrics_secret_3: That scoundrel! He doesn't like my <usual perfume>?!
strings.tr_quest_horadrics_secret_4: I'd rather that he'd taken a mistress!
strings.tr_quest_horadrics_secret_5: Take your <statuette>. I'm gonna give him a piece of my mind!
strings.tr_quest_horadrics_secret_6: I think I better get out of here.
strings.tr_quest_krezvold_once_more_2: Really? I don't believe it, but thank you anyway.
strings.tr_quest_krezvold_once_more_3: Look, <Horadric> purchased a <new perfume> for his wife.
strings.tr_quest_krezvold_once_more_4: Their wedding anniversary is coming up. It's a <surprise> for her.
strings.tr_quest_krezvold_trip_2: Krezvold, where did you go with <Horadric> last week?
strings.tr_quest_krezvold_trip_3: Back off, my workday is over. It's time to have a nice fat steak.
strings.tr_quest_krezvold_trip_4: Why are you always so unfriendly?
strings.tr_quest_krezvold_trip_5: Look, my life is hard and boring. The damned <Contract>!
strings.tr_quest_krezvold_trip_6: I always thought <smithing> was an interesting job. Swords, spears, shields...
strings.tr_quest_krezvold_trip_7: But now I'm forced to make cowbells and spoons for Horadric's inn!
strings.tr_quest_krezvold_trip_8: Hm. How can I get him to tell me?
strings.tr_quest_wine_fl_about_2: Adam, could you answer a small question?
strings.tr_quest_wine_fl_about_3: Someone told me that you were reeking of <alcohol> a few days ago and...
strings.tr_quest_wine_fl_about_4: Oh, you want to hear how life broke me and made me into a pitiful drunkard?
strings.tr_quest_wine_fl_about_6: Then listen to my <tragic tale>! I was born in...
strings.tr_quest_wine_fl_about_7: Okay, okay, just one question. Do you have a <wine flask>?
strings.tr_quest_wine_fl_about_8: No, I use crocks. I make them.
strings.tr_quest_wine_fl_ferm_son_2: I know it's a foolish thought, boy, but do you by any chance drink <wine>?
strings.tr_quest_wine_fl_ferm_son_3: What?! How could you have known that?!
strings.tr_quest_wine_fl_ferm_son_4: Okay, maybe it wasn't so foolish. Could you lend me your <flask>?
strings.tr_quest_wine_fl_ferm_son_5: Well, I'll give you this <flask>, but only if you promise not to tell <my father>.
strings.tr_quest_wine_fl_miller_2: Hi. Excuse me, but do you have a <wine flask>?
strings.tr_quest_wine_fl_miller_4: Of course not, alcohol is disgusting.
strings.tr_quest_wine_fl_miller_5: Except, of course, my special <wheat whiskey>!
strings.tr_quest_wine_fl_miller_6: And what do you drink this <whiskey> from?
strings.tr_quest_wine_fl_miller_7: Straight from the barrel in my cellar!
strings.tr_quest_wine_fl_miller_8: Impressive! I have no more questions.
strings.tress_intro_2: I'm the <Graveyard Keeper>. Nice to meet you.
strings.tress_intro_3: If you need some wooden materials I'll be happy to help you.
strings.tress_intro_4: For stone materials, you can visit my brother <Cory>.
strings.tut_build_1: Use a <blueprint desk> to access the building interface and start building or removing an object in the area.
strings.tut_build_2: Some objects will be built immediately.
strings.tut_build_3: Some of them will need a little extra work with your <Hammer>. This will spend time and <Energy>.
strings.tut_camp_1: Most of buildings in refugee camp increase <Camp Quality> (refugee_happiness_slot).
strings.tut_camp_3: <Satisfaction> (refugee_happiness_filler) fills <Camp Quality> (refugee_happiness_slot) which turns into <Refugee Happiness> (refugee_happiness).
strings.tut_camp_4: <Refugee Happiness> (refugee_happiness) needed for new buildings and new refugees.
strings.tut_energy_1:
Different actions in the game spend your <Energy> ((en)).

Crafting, gathering, and fighting take energy. Fighting has been known to take health as well. (Press %1 to attack)
strings.tut_energy_2: You can always refill your health and energy with <Food> and <Potions>. (Press %1 to open inventory.)
strings.tut_energy_3: <Sleeping> will also restore your health and energy.
strings.tut_grave_1: Use the <blueprint desk> at the graveyard. Mark a site for the grave, then dig it with your shovel.
strings.tut_grave_2: Carefully put the body (or what remains of it) in the grave. Bury. Decorate.
strings.tut_grave_3: WARNING!!! Do not use goat skulls and upside down stars for decoration!
strings.tut_npc_list_1: Each important character who the Graveyard Keeper meets will appear on the characters screen.
strings.tut_npc_list_2: The tasks related to a character are listed to the right of the character.
strings.tut_npc_list_3: The character's relation (from 0(happy) to 100(happy)) is shown below the character.
strings.tut_npc_list_4: Some services require a certain level of (happy).
strings.tut_skulls_1: All human remains have their own unique spiritual attributes. A corpse gets its (rskull)(skull) from its body parts. You can change a corpse's (rskull)(skull) by removing organs and embalming.
strings.tut_skulls_2: The main way to increase your graveyard's (wskull) is to decorate graves with objects that have more (wr).
strings.tut_skulls_3: Each line that has both (skull) and (wr), counts as one (wskull). Lines that have (rskull) never count, but you need to fill them with (wr) to reach (skull) lines.
strings.tut_soul_text_1: Extract <souls> from <bodies>, so they won't waste away in this mortal world.
strings.tut_soul_text_2: Heal <souls> of <sin> with the aid of high-quality organs.
strings.tut_soul_text_3: Send soul back home where it belongs, and receive <gratitude points> (gratitude_points). Use gratitude points for crafting in various zones, but don't forget to build <soul receivers> in these zones first.
strings.tut_soul_text_4: Use gratitude points for crafting in various zones, but don't forget to build soul receivers in these zones first.
strings.tut_soul_text_5: Build workbenches in souls room to increase <gratitude capacity> (soul_zone_capacity).
strings.tut_tavern_1: <Alcohol> for sale in the tavern is stored in the <tavern's cellar>.
strings.tut_tavern_3: A completely full <reputation bar> produces a <reputation star>.
strings.tut_tavern_4: <Reputation stars> are needed for holding <events> at the tavern.
strings.tut_tech_1: To craft new items, you'll need to unlock the relevant technology. This costs tech points. (Press %1 to open the technology tree.)
strings.tut_tech_2: Red points represent your hand-crafting skills, and your ability to work with materials.
strings.tut_tech_3: Green points represent your knowledge about the nature of things and nature itself.
strings.tut_tech_4: Blue points represent your spiritual knowledge of the immaterial world. You'll get your first (b) at the <Study Table> in the Church basement.
strings.tut_tech_5: You earn points simply by doing anything. Also you can get points by studying new items at a special table.
strings.tut_zone_2:
Important location information:
The graveyard quality ((wskull)), the church appeal ((cross)), etc.
strings.tut_zone_3: <Repair Graves> to increase the graveyard's overall quality.
strings.tut_zone_4: You'll probably need special resources to do that...
strings.tutorial_take_items: Use %1 to pick up and drop large items.
strings.unicorn_horn_d: Awaken your internal unicorn! Rainbows not included.
strings.vampire_sunscreen_d: Adequate evidence of a vampire's demise. At least, according to Alaric.
strings.vampires_blackened_boot_d: Got of lucky compared with its owner.
strings.vendor_tier_lock_info: These items are locked until the vendor gets to Tier %1.
strings.vendor_tier_lock_next: The vendor will unlock this tier of items tomorrow.

strings.witchers_eye_d: Delivers its bearer visions of the past. Cranky. Only works when it wants to.
strings.working_tent_3: Juicy burgers! Sweet as holy ecstasy!
strings.you_need_dlc_stories: You need a DLC to load this save.
strings.youve_unlocked_tech: You've unlocked a new technology and got:
strings.zombie_after_hit_1: First feeling I've had for many years.
strings.zombie_after_hit_2: Now I'll be happy to answer your questions.
strings.zombie_after_hit_a6: Hmm. That's a complicated question. Personally, I prefer to be called a undead person.
strings.zombie_after_hit_a7: But in popular culture we're known as zombies.
strings.zombie_after_hit_b10: And I have too little flesh on my bones to waste it.
strings.zombie_after_hit_b3: Why did you ask me to hit you?
strings.zombie_after_hit_b4: Oh, in my current situation, I can feel nothing...
strings.zombie_after_hit_b5: First it was a nightmare, but then I found out that I can still feel pain.
strings.zombie_after_hit_b6: It doesn't feel like pain, though. More like a gentle breeze. But still, it's all I have.
strings.zombie_after_hit_b7: I can hit you again if you like.
strings.zombie_after_hit_b8: That's very kind of you. But I must refuse.
strings.zombie_after_hit_b9: After so many years, your strikes were truly a pleasure. It will be a couple of years before I can feel anything like it.
strings.zombie_after_hit_c4: Science! Plus a little bit of magic. The old master made me. Actually he made a lot of us.
strings.zombie_after_hit_c5: Do my brothers still work at the Graveyard?
strings.zombie_after_hit_c6: No, I think there's only you.
strings.zombie_after_hit_c7: By the way, I'm the new Graveyard Keeper.
strings.zombie_after_hit_c8: Oh! Then you should make me some more brothers. They'll be a big help for you.
strings.zombie_after_hit_d4: Oh it's quite simple. You can find a resurrection table blueprint on the rack, to your left.
strings.zombie_after_hit_d5: There should be also be a couple bottles of the main resurrection ingredients nearby.
strings.zombie_after_hit_d6: You can make more at the alchemy desk.
strings.zombie_after_hit_d8: Well, the second ingredient is blood. I'm not sure about the first... but I think it's some kind of powder.
strings.zombie_after_hit_e4: Sadly no. I am unique. Something went wrong with me. I was too smart.
strings.zombie_after_hit_e5: That's why the old master chained me here. I didn't fit in.
strings.zombie_after_hit_e6_a2: I've been chained up here for too long. My flesh is too rotten. Plus, I kind of like it here.
strings.zombie_after_hit_f4: Oh they can do simple crafts for you.
strings.zombie_after_hit_f5: If you give them the right gear, they'll be able to gather resources for you, and even transport them.
strings.zombie_after_hit_f7: Hmm. I believe one zombie should be buried under the rocks along the path to the forest.
strings.zombie_after_hit_f8: You can dig him up and examine his gear.
strings.zombie_crafting_table_d: Make zombie workers from bodies here.
strings.zombie_help_1_2: The first is some kind of powder. I don't remember exactly which one. The second ingredient is blood.
strings.zombie_help_2_2: There's a pass to the forest area to the north of the church.
strings.zombie_help_2_3: My undead brother should be buried somewhere under the rocks there.
strings.zombie_intro_0: Sounds like someone moaning for help...
strings.zombie_intro_10a: Could you first answer a question?
strings.zombie_intro_11a: Please hit me first. I haven't felt anything for so long...
strings.zombie_intro_2a: Maybe, maybe not. This place hides many things. Not that I care, unless it has to do with my plan.
strings.zombie_intro_3: Indeed! What a pleasant surprise. I've been so desperate to see someone again.
strings.zombie_intro_4: Are you alive ? Do you need help?
strings.zombie_intro_5: Let's just say I'm conscious. And I'm glad to hear you so kindly offer your help. My name is Gunter.
strings.zombie_intro_6: There should be a lever on the right.
strings.zombie_intro_8: Great! I'm surprised it's still working.
strings.zombie_intro_9: Now would you be so kind as to hit me with your sword a couple of times.
strings.сlotho_intro_1: I'm not a spirit. I'm the keeper at the local graveyard.
strings.сlotho_intro_11: Do you see a <Cauldron> lying around?
strings.сlotho_intro_13: Neither do I. So we have two options here. You can either make me this potion. It's shouldn't be too hard.
strings.сlotho_intro_14: Or you can bring me a new <Cauldron> and get the ingredients for me.
strings.сlotho_intro_16: Oh I'll need a big one. A good <blacksmith> might know how to make one.
strings.сlotho_intro_17: You help me, and I'll help you.
strings.сlotho_intro_18: I might even become your princess... ha ha!
strings.сlotho_intro_19: I'm thinking of a third option... run away and never look back!
strings.сlotho_intro_4a_2: I've been trying to figure that out for a couple weeks now. And I have a few theories.
strings.сlotho_intro_4b: I think you might be <Clotho>, the witch from the swamp.
strings.сlotho_intro_4b_1: Oh, that would explain one of my theories... in part. Come closer, my sweet.
strings.сlotho_intro_5: Do I look more like a witch or a fairy princess? What do you think?
strings.сlotho_intro_6a_2: I'm too smart to be a princess.
strings.сlotho_intro_6b_1: Great! Then you can be my prince!
strings.сlotho_intro_8: I remember nothing. I just woke up with this note in my hand.
strings.сlotho_intro_9_1: In case you lose your memory: just boil the <Cauldron> with the <Incense> and the <Bee>.
strings.сlotho_intro_9_2: Drink the result. All ingredients should be in the <Cauldron> already. Good luck, from your past you.
strings.сlotho_merch_1: He told me that he knew you well. He used to buy love potions from you with his friend, the priest.
strings.сlotho_merch_10: Chemist... Alchemist. Right! So you can craft a potion for him. And I'll tell you the recipe.
strings.сlotho_merch_2: Oh I remember. They we so sweet. But they were brothers as I recall.
strings.сlotho_merch_3: So how can I help him?
strings.сlotho_merch_4: He ate some <Hiccup-Grass> and lost his sense of taste. He thinks he's cursed!
strings.сlotho_merch_5: Sounds like a curse laid on him by another witch. So it would be unprofessional of me to help him.
strings.сlotho_merch_6: In the old times, we used to help out in situations like this, but then the whole market collapsed. Now it's forbidden.
strings.сlotho_merch_7: Only the witch who placed the curse on him can craft a potion to remove it.
strings.сlotho_merch_8: So there's no cure for him?
strings.сlotho_merch_9: Let me see... I've told you the basics... And you're no witcher. There's a fancy word for what you are...
strings.сlotho_pot_1: Hmm... Looks good, let's try it!
strings.сlotho_pot_3: And I remember where I hid my <Cauldron>!
strings.сlotho_pot_4: Ok. Now I'm back. So what do you need from old <Clotho>?
strings.сlotho_pot_5: I got some good stuff, you know. You won't find potions this good anywhere these days!
strings.сlotho_vat_1: Good, now I need those ingredients!
strings.сlotho_vat_done: Good. Now let's see how it works.
strings.сlotho_vat_done_1: Hm. Let's check if it's ready.
strings.сlotho_vat_done_4: It was nice being a princess. Heh.
strings.сlotho_vat_done_5: I made too much. Here's an extra potion for you.
strings.сlotho_vat_done_6: Ok. Now I'm back. So what do you need from old <Clotho>?
strings.сlotho_vat_done_7: I got some good stuff, you know. You won't find potions this good anywhere these days!
